Wang Xiaoming.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Wang Xiaoming**

Wang Xiaoming, affectionately known as "Obviously" among friends and colleagues, is a 28-year-old software development engineer hailing from China. Possessing a keen intellect and an insatiable curiosity, Wang Xiaoming has carved out a reputable niche for himself in the bustling world of technology. With a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Technology, he has been instrumental at his role in a well-known technology company, where his innovative ideas and meticulous approach have not gone unnoticed.

Recognizable by his short hair and glasses, Wang Xiaoming’s dedication to his craft is matched by his enthusiasm for photography and basketball, hobbies that allow him to unwind and find inspiration outside the rigors of his demanding job. His drive and commitment to excellence earned him the first prize in the National Youth Science and Technology Innovation Competition, marking him as one of the bright minds of his generation.

Proud of his Han nationality heritage, Wang Xiaoming draws inspiration from the esteemed Academician Li Ziming, whose research and engineering advancements serve as a beacon for his own professional journey. With each project, Wang strives to embody his role model's spirit of continuous learning and relentless progress.

1_0_0.content: Wang Xiaoming and his sister Wang Xiaohong decided to explore the Grand Canyon in Arizona, USA. They set off early in the morning on May 12, 2022, and took a plane to Arizona. After arriving at their destination, they rented a car and headed to the Colorado Plateau, where the Grand Canyon is located. They obtained detailed tourist information at the local tourist center and decided to visit the North Caninu Canyon first. They walked along the winding trails and enjoyed the stunning views of the Grand Canyon. In the North Caninu Canyon, they saw towering cliffs and wide and deep canyons, as well as magnificent rock pillars and spires such as Fairy Peak, Blue Tower and Red Tower. Wang Xiaoming took out his camera and enthusiastically photographed the magnificent scenery of the Grand Canyon. Wang Xiaohong used her mobile phone to record this beautiful moment. Later, they visited the City of the Sun and were attracted by the golden brilliance of the ancient river bed rocks illuminated by the sun. In the Grand Canyon area, they also saw the rapids and waterfalls of the Colorado River, such as Sea Falls and Panther Falls, and felt the majestic momentum of the water. In addition to admiring the scenery, they encountered some rare flora and fauna, such as Canadian snowy owls, mountain lions and California lizards. They camped at a campsite in the Grand Canyon area and watched the beautiful starry sky at night. Wang Xiaoming and Wang Xiaohong had a great time as a family, and they left many wonderful memories in the Grand Canyon.
1_0_0.Theme: Wang Xiaoming and Wang Xiaohong’s family trip

1_0_1.content: Wang Xiaoming's sister, Wang Xiaohong, heard about Luyingju's environmentally friendly home furnishings and was very interested. She decided to invite Wang Xiaoming to visit them. They agreed to visit the exhibition at Green Yingju on October 15, 2022. Wang Xiaoming and Wang Xiaohong admired the environmentally friendly home work called 'Green House' together. During the exhibition, they first entered a living room decorated in a fresh and natural style. Wang Xiaoming pointed to natural materials and green building materials and told Wang Xiaohong that these environmentally friendly materials can protect the environment and at the same time provide healthy and comfortable living spaces. They noticed that the furniture in the living room was made of environmentally friendly boards, such as European environmentally friendly E0-grade boards, which do not contain formaldehyde and other harmful substances. Water-based environmentally friendly materials are also used for dyes and coatings to ensure healthy indoor air quality. In addition, Wang Xiaoming also introduced to Wang Xiaohong the high-efficiency, low-energy-consumption environmentally friendly air-conditioning system adopted by Luyingju. This system uses intelligent temperature control technology to automatically adjust the operating status of the air conditioner according to changes in indoor and outdoor temperature and humidity, optimizing energy consumption and reducing the impact on the environment. There are also green plants in the exhibition. Wang Xiaoming told Wang Xiaohong that green plants can increase the humidity of indoor air, purify the air, and create a healthy and comfortable living environment. Finally, Wang Xiaoming pointed to the solar panels and told Wang Xiaohong that Luyingju's works also use solar power generation systems, which convert solar energy into electrical energy to power lighting and electrical equipment in the home, achieving energy conservation and emission reduction. Wang Xiaohong expressed her appreciation for the design and innovation of these environmentally friendly homes and decided to introduce some environmentally friendly elements into her own home. They had a pleasant time at the exhibition and enhanced mutual understanding and communication.
1_0_1.summary: Visit the exhibition of Green Yingju’s environmentally friendly home furnishing works

1_0_2.content: Wang Xiaohong is Wang Xiaoming's sister, who is similar in age and is a doctor. They have a very close relationship and often spend family time together. In Zhang Hua's case, Wang Xiaoming consulted Wang Xiaohong about issues related to the Constitution and freedom of speech. Wang Xiaohong used a doctor's professional sensitivity and interest in law to help Wang Xiaoming understand the basic rights and obligations of citizens stipulated in the constitution, especially the importance of freedom of speech. Together they studied similar cases and relevant legal provisions, and jointly analyzed the views of the government and defense attorneys. Wang Xiaohong provided moral support to Wang Xiaoming and encouraged him to file a lawsuit with the Constitutional Court to safeguard his legitimate rights and interests. Wang Xiaohong also helped Wang Xiaoming prepare some legal documents and evidence to support his case. During the trial, Wang Xiaohong, as Wang Xiaoming's family and friend, has been by his side to provide support and encouragement. Together, they look forward to Judge Li Ming's fair judgment and believe that justice will be done.
1_0_2.summary: Episode memories related to Zhang Hua’s case

1_2_0.content: On May 10, 2022, Wang Xiaoming and his romantic partner Li Ting embarked on a wonderful photography trip. They chose picturesque countryside as their location to capture the beauty and serenity of nature. In the morning, they took their favorite cameras and lenses and walked into an ancient village. There they discovered an ancient stone bridge with a crystal clear stream flowing through it. They quickly set up their tripod, adjusted their camera parameters, and began capturing this beautiful scene. Li Ting passionately guided Wang Xiaoming on how to choose the best composition and angle. They carefully capture every detail, from the stones on the bridge to the reflections in the water, and each photo demonstrates their photography talent and sensitivity to beauty. For lunch, they found a local farmhouse and tasted authentic farmhouse dishes. After lunch, they continued walking and came to a large wheat field next to a windmill. Li Ting found an excellent shooting spot in the middle of the wheat field. She lay in the wheat field and took a series of stunning photos from a low angle. Wang Xiaoming stood next to the windmill and captured the magnificent view of the rotating blades and wheat fields. Throughout the afternoon, they traveled through this beautiful countryside, constantly looking for new shooting spots and ideas. In the evening, they came to a high mountain and greeted the afterglow of the setting sun. They stood on the top of the mountain, looking at the mountains and lakes in the distance. This moment seemed to be stuck at the end of time. Together they captured the stunning sunset, and the day's photography trip came to a successful end. This photography trip not only allowed Wang Xiaoming and Li Ting to fully demonstrate their photography skills, but also deepened their relationship. They inspire each other, help each other, and create many beautiful moments together.
1_2_0.Theme: Photography trip of Wang Xiaoming and Li Ting

1_5_0.content: Wang Xiaoming and his mentor Zhang Wen discussed in depth the applications and challenges of CAR-T cell therapy at a scientific and technological innovation seminar. This discussion took place in the conference room of a well-known technology company in Beijing. Wang Xiaoming showed Zhang Wen cases and works on CAR-T cell therapy, especially his research and improvement results on key steps in CAR-T cell therapy. He mentioned a study he was involved in that used CRISPR gene-editing technology and viral vector-mediated gene transduction to successfully engineer T cells so that they could more effectively recognize and attack cancer cells. Wang Xiaoming also mentioned the remarkable success of CAR-T cell therapy in clinical practice, especially the case of CAR-T cell therapy Kymriah developed by Novartis Pharmaceuticals for the treatment of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Wang Xiaoming and Zhang Wen discussed the challenges that CAR-T cell therapy may face, including immune response and treatment costs. They recognized that CAR-T cell therapy is an important innovative technology in the field of immune system and brings new hope to cancer patients, but it also requires further research and improvement. Zhang Wen expressed appreciation for Wang Xiaoming's research results and encouraged him to continue to conduct in-depth research and explore the potential of CAR-T cell therapy.

1_7_2.content: Wang Xiaoming and Chen Hua participated in a mathematics discussion at a community event. The theme of this symposium is differential geometry, and one of the classic cases is the Klein bottle in Riemannian geometry. At the seminar, Wang Xiaoming introduced the special properties and research fields of Klein bottles. He explained in detail the construction of a Klein bottle and its applications in mathematics and physics. Chen Hua was very interested in this case. He raised some questions and had an in-depth discussion with Wang Xiaoming. Together they discussed the topological properties and geometric structure of Klein bottles and their significance in space-time curvature and quantum field theory. This symposium not only deepened Wang Xiaoming's understanding of differential geometry, but also provided Chen Hua with a new mathematical perspective. After the symposium, Wang Xiaoming and Chen Hua decided to continue to study Klein bottles in depth and planned to collaborate to explore more issues related to differential geometry in future mathematical research.

Li Hua.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Li Hua**

Li Hua, affectionately known by his nickname Xiaohua, is a 30-year-old contemporary artist from China. As a freelance creator, Li Hua has passionately pursued his artistic endeavors across various mediums including painting, sculpture, and photography. His slender figure, short black hair, and distinctive black-rimmed glasses complement his artistic persona, while his ethnic background as an Asian provides a rich cultural tapestry influencing his work.

Educated in modern art, Li Hua's artistic journey is marked by numerous achievements. His innovative pieces have graced many domestic and international art exhibitions, earning him prestigious art awards and acclaim from critics and peers alike. Li Hua attributes his success to the influence of his role model, the celebrated contemporary art master Zhang Yimou, whose visionary works inspire him to push the boundaries of his own creative expression.

A proud ambassador of his national heritage, Li Hua brings a unique perspective to the global art scene through his distinctive style and thought-provoking creations. His works continue to captivate audiences, offering fresh insights and deep reflections on the world around us. As Li Hua progresses in his career, his name is becoming increasingly synonymous with the evolution of contemporary art.

Wang Ming.profile_description:
**Wang Ming**

**Protagonist**: Wang Ming  
**Nickname**: Obviously  
**Title**: Agricultural Resource Manager  
**Age**: 30  
**Occupation**: Agricultural Resource Manager  
**Nationality**: China  

Wang Ming, known affectionately as "Obviously," is an accomplished agricultural resource manager hailing from China. With a medium build, short black hair, and glasses, he is a dedicated professional who has turned his passion for agriculture into a thriving career. As a member of the Han nationality, Wang has pursued his education rigorously, specializing in agricultural resource management. This education has empowered him to contribute significantly to the agricultural sector.

In his role at a leading agricultural company, Wang Ming has achieved impressive results, notably increasing crop yields through his innovative approaches. His hard work and ingenuity were recognized with the prestigious Agricultural Science and Technology Innovation Award. Wang draws inspiration from his role model, Li Ming, an esteemed agricultural scientist.

Beyond his professional accomplishments, Wang Ming is enthusiastic about growing vegetables and raising poultry, hobbies that reflect his deep connection to agriculture. His practical experience and commitment to sustainable farming practices make him a valuable asset to his employer and a respected figure in the agricultural community. Wang Ming's story is one of dedication, innovation, and respect for nature.

3_0_1.content: Wang Hong was an economist who played an important role in the wartime economy. As Wang Ming's wife, she worked with him to study and analyze the application of Wal-Mart's economic model in American wartime economic management. Wang Hong conducted an in-depth study of the procurement mechanism of the Ministry of Munitions and cooperated with private enterprises to establish a wartime supply network to ensure efficient distribution of materials. She also examines the transformation of military factories and the price control policies and rationing systems implemented by the government. Wang Hong also participated in the study of the war bond plan and provided important suggestions for raising war funds. Together with other economists, she assisted President Roosevelt and the War Economic Commission in formulating wartime economic policies, ensuring the successful application of the Wal-Mart economic model in the victory of the war. Wang Hong's contribution played an important role in ensuring the supply and support of the army.
3_0_1.summary: Wang Hong’s role in the wartime economy

Among them, the Dingding beef patty has become their favorite. It is tender and juicy in the mouth and makes them have endless aftertaste. During the meal, Wang Ming and Li Ming also talked about their beautiful memories in college and commemorated the time they spent together. They lamented the passage of time, but they were still each other's best friends. They were also deeply impressed by the attentive service of Dingding Hot Pot Head Office. The professional waiter team and personalized seasoning suggestions made them feel at home. Wang Ming and Li Ming also used the quick ordering system provided in the store to conveniently and quickly order their favorite condiments, such as coriander, minced garlic, pepper powder, chili oil, etc. During the whole meal, they tasted the delicious food and chatted about each other's current situation, spending a pleasant and unforgettable evening.

He participated in the experimental work of the research team using chemical vapor deposition to synthesize large-area MoS2 monolayer films. **Protagonist: Zhang Xiaohong**

Zhang Xiaohong, affectionately known as Xiaohong, is a dedicated chemical pharmaceutical engineer whose expertise and passion are making waves in the pharmaceutical industry. At 28, Xiaohong has already established herself as a prominent figure in her field, having earned a Master's Degree in Chemical Pharmaceutical Engineering from a prestigious university in China. Her academic prowess was further demonstrated when she won the first prize in the National Chemical and Pharmaceutical Engineering Competition.

With her black hair, dark eyes, and a healthy complexion, Xiaohong embodies the vibrant spirit of a young professional driven by ambition and curiosity. Her career as a chemical pharmaceutical engineer at a renowned pharmaceutical company showcases her commitment to advancing medical science and developing innovative solutions.

Beyond her professional life, Xiaohong indulges in hobbies that enrich her personal experience. She is an avid reader, often exploring scientific literature and novels alike, and finds joy in traveling to discover new cultures and perspectives. Her culinary adventures allow her creativity to flourish, as she enjoys experimenting with diverse ingredients and flavors.

Inspired by the groundbreaking achievements of Marie Curie, Xiaohong is motivated to make significant contributions to her field, aiming to leave a lasting impact just like her role model did. Her journey is characterized by a blend of technical excellence and a heartfelt dedication to improving lives through pharmaceutical advancements. As a proud Asian woman, Xiaohong continues to embody the values of perseverance, innovation, and cultural appreciation, striving for a future where her contributions pave the way for healthier and more informed global communities.

4_2_2.content: One day, Zhang Xiaohong and her boyfriend Li Yang spent a pleasant evening together. During the conversation, they talked about the field of developmental psychology, specifically Stanley Milgram’s “obedience experiments.” Zhang Xiaohong was very interested in this experiment, and she asked Li Yang for more details. Li Yang explained that the experiment was designed to study whether people would abandon their personal moral judgment and take shocking actions when instructed by an authority figure. He told Zhang Xiaohong that the experiment set up a hypothetical learning task, and participants were told that they needed to give electric shocks to a 'learner' in another room to help him remember a series of words. However, these shocks were fake and did not actually cause any real harm. Li Yang further explained that in the experiment, there was a conductor who encouraged participants to continue giving electric shocks to the 'learners' even if the 'learners' showed obvious pain and resistance. He told Zhang Xiaohong that the results showed that more than 60% of the participants were willing to keep applying electric shocks, even if they heard the 'learners' claiming that their physical condition was not good or even unconscious. Zhang Xiaohong was shocked by the results of this experiment and began to think about people's tendency to obey under pressure from authority. She and Li Yang engaged in an in-depth discussion exploring the impact of personality traits, cultural differences, and situational factors on human submissive behavior. This night, Zhang Xiaohong and Li Yang not only deepened their understanding of each other, but also jointly discovered the importance of Stanley Milgram's experiments to psychology.

Together, they studied the wide range of applications of this encoding technology in communication and storage systems, such as satellite communications, digital television, and mobile communications. Liu Liang told Wang Li that Reed-Solomon coding can achieve forward error correction by adding redundant information. Zhao Li.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Zhao Li**

Zhao Li, affectionately known as Lili, is a prominent military strategy expert from China, currently serving as a distinguished military strategist for the Chinese military. At the age of 40, she has established herself as a towering figure in the realm of military operations, characterized by her tall stature, healthy complexion, and sharp, observant eyes that reflect her keen strategic insight.

With a rich educational background in military strategy, Zhao Li has dedicated her life to mastering the art of warfare. Her passion is evident in her hobbies, which include reading military-related books, engaging in military simulation exercises, and delving deep into war history. Her expertise and dedication have led her to successfully guide numerous crucial military operations, earning her multiple prestigious awards, including the China Military Strategy Outstanding Contribution Award.

Drawing inspiration from General Li Bai’s strategic thinking, Lili continuously refines her skills and strategies, making her an invaluable asset to the Chinese military. Her Asian heritage and commitment to excellence make her a role model for aspiring strategists, as she leads with intelligence, precision, and an unwavering commitment to national defense.

6_0_3.content: When Zhao Li and her brother Zhang Ming discussed medicinal chemistry at home, they mentioned the classic example of aspirin. Together they shared the pharmacological effects and chemical structure of aspirin. Zhao Li told Zhang Ming that aspirin is an over-the-counter drug that is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) and is widely used in pain relief, fever reduction, and anti-inflammation. She explained that the chemical name of aspirin is acetylsalicylic acid, a derivative of salicylic acid. Zhao Li introduced the molecular structure of aspirin to Zhang Ming, which consists of a benzene ring, an acyl group and a carboxyl group. The chemical formula of acetylsalicylic acid is C9H8O4, and its molecular weight is 180.16 g/mol. She told Zhang Ming that the pharmacological effect of aspirin is based on its inhibitory effect on cyclooxygenase. By combining with cyclooxygenase, it blocks its activity and reduces the occurrence of inflammation and the feeling of pain. In addition, Zhao Li also explained to Zhang Ming that aspirin has anti-platelet aggregation effects and can prevent the formation of thrombosis. They discussed the widespread use of aspirin in the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. Zhao Li and Zhang Ming were surprised by the importance and widespread use of aspirin, and expressed their great interest in learning medicinal chemistry.

Zhao Li explained that Geely Automobile Group has gained a competitive advantage in the U.S. market by reducing costs and improving product quality, making cars produced in China more competitive in price in the U.S. market. This has led to increased sales of Chinese cars in the U.S. market, while at the same time relatively few U.S. cars are being sold in the Chinese market. Zhao Li also mentioned that in order to reduce the Sino-US trade deficit, the US government has introduced a series of policy measures, including imposing additional tariffs on cars imported from China and increasing the protection of intellectual property rights for Chinese companies. After hearing this, Wang Li said that this issue is indeed complex and requires joint efforts from all countries to solve it. **Protagonist: Chen Zhi**

Chen Zhi, often affectionately referred to by his friends as "Will," is a distinguished gentleman at the age of 30. With his black hair and dark eyes, he presents a charismatic presence, complemented by his healthy physique.

Chen's educational background in agricultural policy has provided him with a solid foundation for his career, leading him to work at a prominent agricultural research institute. His contributions to the field are substantial, having published several influential research papers that have made waves in the academic community. His efforts have not gone unnoticed, earning him the Outstanding Youth Award in agricultural policy research, a testament to his dedication and impact.

Influenced by his role model, Li Nong, Chen Zhi continually strives for excellence, motivated by the legacy of pioneering figures in the industry. They spent several days at Amundsen-Scott Station, witnessing firsthand the stunning scenery and unique architectural design of this permanent scientific research station. They visited laboratories, accommodation facilities, and medical stations and learned about the various scientific experiments and observations that scientists conduct in this extreme environment. Yang Lele was shocked by the scientific research and international cooperation here, and she admired the construction and operation of the Amundsen-Scott Station. During the visit, Yang Lele and Yang Wei enjoyed the magnificent scenery of Antarctica, including the snow-covered landscape and wild animals. They also attended a special lecture and learned about Antarctica's geography, climate change, and conservation policies. This visit gave Yang Lele a deeper understanding of Yang Wei’s ecological design work and his love for the natural environment. The time they spent at Amundsen-Scott Station brought them closer together, and together they felt the unique charm of Antarctica, the mysterious ice and snow continent.

8_1_0.content: Yang Wei and his friend Zhang Liang visited the work 'The Last Supper' created by Italian painter Leonardo da Vinci in the monastery of Santa Maria de Grave in Milan. They were struck by the mural's delicate painting techniques and superb perspective effects. In the work, Yang Wei and Zhang Liang carefully observed the dramatic atmosphere created by Leonardo da Vinci's use of light, shadow and color. They noted the religious meaning conveyed by the expressions, gestures, and postures of Jesus and his disciples. Yang Wei was particularly attracted by the triangle formed by Jesus' body leaning forward, arms and palms, symbolizing sacrifice and betrayal. Zhang Liang was fascinated by the disciples' expressions of various emotions, such as surprise, anger and confusion, demonstrating the complexity of human nature and the emotional conflicts in religious stories. They also noted the architectural structure of the monastery and the decorative details in the interior, including vaults, columns and niches, which enhance the work's sense of realism and space. Yang Wei and Zhang Liang discussed in depth 'The Last Supper' as an example of the combination of art and religion during the Renaissance, as well as the artistic value of Leonardo da Vinci's successful integration of art and religious themes. They were very pleased with how engaging and thought-provoking the work was, and were inspired in the realm of combining art and religion.

Yang Wei and Zhang Liang are both adventurers who love outdoor activities, and they often explore various charming natural landscapes together. On this expedition, they will cross rugged mountains, climb high peaks, and trek through dense forests. They will carry backpacks equipped with food, water, and safety equipment to ensure their safety in the wild. 8_1_2.content: Yang Wei and his friend Zhang Liang went on a hiking adventure together on a sunny weekend. Along the way, they talked about anti-counterfeiting label cases in the shopping and consumer fields. Yang Wei mentioned the anti-counterfeiting marking system called “SafeTrace” launched by ABC brand. He introduced to Zhang Liang that the SafeTrace system integrates a number of advanced technologies and builds a comprehensive anti-counterfeiting system by using multiple technical means such as QR codes, RFID radio frequency identification, physical particle marking and infrared scanning. Yang Wei explained in detail the role of printing unique QR codes and attached RFID tags on product packaging. Consumers can read the RFID tag information by scanning the QR code or using the NFC function of their mobile phones. He also mentioned that the core technology of the SafeTrace system is physical particle marking, which can embed tiny physical particles into product materials with a unique identification code that cannot be copied or imitated. Yang Wei also introduced to Zhang Liang the value-added services provided by the SafeTrace system, such as understanding product production information and submitting quality complaints. The two discussed the positive impact of the SafeTrace system on protecting consumer rights and brand reputation, and believed that this was an innovative case for ABC brand in anti-counterfeiting marking in the shopping and consumer fields.
8_1_2.summary: Discuss cases of anti-counterfeiting labels in the shopping and consumer fields

8_2_0.content: Yang Wei and Li Li decided to visit a famous physics laboratory together, where a double-slit interference experiment was conducted. They saw experimental devices such as electrons, blocking plates, double slits and recording boards in the laboratory. Yang Wei explained to Li Li the purpose and principle of this experiment in detail, as well as its importance in quantum mechanics. Li Li was very interested in this experiment. She and Yang Wei carefully observed the experimental process together. When only one slit was open, they saw electrons forming a single-slit diffraction pattern on the recording plate. When both slits were opened, they were amazed to see the electrons forming a series of alternating light and dark interference fringes on the recording plate. Yang Wei and Li Li were deeply shocked by the results of this experiment, and they couldn't help but begin to explore the wave-particle duality in quantum mechanics and the impact of observations in the experiment. The visit made them even more passionate about physics and scientific exploration, and further deepened their romantic relationship.

Xu Jia.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Xu Jia**

Xu Jia, affectionately known as Allison, is a distinguished 28-year-old film and television professional hailing from China. With a medium build and striking features marked by her black hair and dark eyes, Xu Jia embodies a captivating presence both behind the camera and in her professional sphere. Her deep-rooted passion for film is evident through her hobbies, which include watching movies, shooting short films, and editing videos. These interests have seamlessly translated into a successful career, with Xu Jia earning multiple accolades in the film and television industry.

An alumna of Film and Television Studies, Xu Jia has honed her craft under the inspiration of renowned director Ang Lee, whose works serve as her guiding beacon. Her expertise and dedication have led her to secure prestigious awards, including the Best Screenplay Award and Best Director Award, affirming her status as a luminary in the field. Employed by a reputable film production company, Xu Jia continues to influence the industry with her innovative storytelling and directional prowess.

Rooted in her Asian heritage, Xu Jia's work reflects a rich cultural tapestry that resonates with audiences worldwide, making her a formidable and inspiring figure in the realm of cinema.

Sun Xiaoming.profile_description:
Sun Xiaoming, known fondly as Xiaoming, is a passionate ecologist hailing from China. At 32, he has established himself as a dedicated researcher and educator at XX University, where his work focuses on ecological and environmental protection. With a medium build, short black hair, and glasses, Xiaoming is often seen exploring the great outdoors, camera in hand, capturing the beauty and complexity of natural ecosystems.

His journey in ecology was fueled by an educational background in the field, leading to the publication of numerous academic papers that have contributed significantly to understanding environmental issues and proposing sustainable solutions. Xiaoming's commitment to his work has been recognized through prestigious awards, including the XX scholarship, which celebrates his contribution to ecological research.

Beyond his academic endeavors, Xiaoming is an avid outdoor adventurer and photographer, seamlessly merging his professional interests with personal hobbies. His role model, Jayne Goodell, has inspired him to push boundaries in his field, aiming for innovative ways to protect and conserve the environment. As a proud Asian, Xiaoming brings a unique perspective to global ecological conversations, striving for a greener future through science and education.

10_0_0.content: On March 15, 2022, Sun Xiaoming's father, a retired engineer, was very proud after learning that Sun Xiaoming had made outstanding achievements in academia. He was sincerely gratified for Sun Xiaoming's hard work and talent. He was also happy that he taught at XX University and received the XX scholarship. He believes that Sun Xiaoming's achievements are comparable to Jayne Goodell, which is a very remarkable achievement. He expressed appreciation for Sun Xiaoming's academic paper output and contribution to ecological and environmental protection, and was full of expectations for his future development. This affectionate and supportive relationship between father and son provides Sun Xiaoming with a solid backing and inspires him to continue to achieve more achievements in the field of ecology.

He said that Sun Xiaoming's efforts and talents have been widely recognized in the academic world, and he hoped that he could continue to make more achievements in the field of ecology. Sun Ming also mentioned that he once talked with some friends about Sun Xiaoming's academic achievements. They all spoke highly of Sun Xiaoming's research work and believed that he had a deep understanding of the ecological education background. Sun Xiaoming was encouraged by these praises and recognitions, and he was determined to continue working hard and make greater contributions to the cause of ecological and environmental protection.

10_1_0.content: Sun Xiaoming and his college classmate Li Jing participated in an ecological inspection and outdoor adventure trip. This expedition was conducted on June 15, 2010, in a nature reserve in China. The group rented professional ecological investigation equipment, such as telescopes and photographic equipment, to better observe and record the ecological habits of wild animals and plants. They conducted a week-long expedition along the designated route, during which they also conducted wild camping and wild barbecue activities. During the inspection, Sun Xiaoming and Li Jing jointly faced various challenges in the natural environment, such as steep mountain roads, winding trails and slippery rivers. They helped and encouraged each other and shared many unforgettable moments. During this inspection, Sun Xiaoming and Li Jing not only deepened their knowledge and understanding of the ecological environment, but also cultivated a sense of awe for nature, which further consolidated their friendship.
10_1_0.Theme: Ecological expeditions and outdoor adventure tours

10_1_1.content: Sun Xiaoming and his college classmate Li Jing participated in an unforgettable ecological inspection and outdoor adventure trip. This inspection trip took place on May 12, 2022, in an advanced city called 'Green Smart City' in the western region of a virtual country.

10_1_2.content: In 2010, Sun Xiaoming and his college classmate Li Jing participated in the socially responsible investment projects of Company A and Company B. They jointly participated in the construction of a large-scale solar photovoltaic power station in a remote area of country X. As an ecologist, Sun Xiaoming’s professional knowledge and experience are very important for the environmental assessment and sustainable development of the project. Together with Li Jing, he participated in comprehensive environmental assessment work to ensure that the project met strict environmental standards during construction and operation. They work closely with local governments, environmental organizations and community representatives to ensure that relevant laws, regulations and social responsibility guidelines are followed during the construction of the project. In addition, they regularly monitor and evaluate the operation of the power station to ensure that it meets environmental and social standards. During the operation phase of the project, Sun Xiaoming and Li Jing also actively participated in interactions with the local community, shared the project's benefits, and invested in local education, medical care and infrastructure construction to improve the quality of life of local residents. Through collaboration and hard work, they have brought renewable energy and employment opportunities to local communities while achieving sustainable development and social benefits. This socially responsible investment project not only won Company A a good social reputation and widespread recognition, but also allowed Sun Xiaoming and Li Jing to make positive contributions in the fields of ecological protection and sustainable development.
10_1_2.summary: Participate in the construction of solar photovoltaic power stations

10_2_0.content: Sun Xiaoming and his girlfriend Zhang Li are a pair of ecologists who love nature and environmental protection. They met when they were graduate students and pursued the cause of environmental protection together. On August 15, 2019, they decided to observe the Gammaid meteor shower together. Sun Xiaoming did detailed research in advance and learned that the Gammaid meteor shower was caused by the asteroid 3200 Phaethon, which was discovered by NASA's Gamma Space Telescope. The Gammaid meteor shower is characterized by a relatively slow meteor speed of approximately 35 kilometers per hour, resulting in long and relatively bright meteor trajectories. They chose a place far away from the light pollution of the city, brought photography equipment and hot drinks, and prepared to spend this anticipated night together. That night, they spread out their blankets on a grassy field and looked up at the stars. As night falls, the Gammad meteor shower begins. Meteors pass through the night sky and across the sea of stars, beautiful and spectacular. Sun Xiaoming and Zhang Li took many photos of each other to record this unforgettable moment. During the meteor shower observation process, they not only enjoyed the wonders of nature, but also deepened their feelings for each other. This romantic observation activity strengthened their determination to protect the environment. They hope that through their efforts, more people will realize the preciousness of natural resources and jointly protect our earth home.
10_2_0.summary: Observe the Gammaid Meteor Shower together

10_2_1.content: Sun Xiaoming and his girlfriend Zhang Li, as ecologists, met during their graduate studies and pursued a career in environmental protection together. One day in spring, they stepped into a beautiful courtyard with green grass and a cool breeze. Sun Xiaoming admired the dancing azaleas in the courtyard, while Zhang Li was attracted by the sound of pipa in the courtyard. She told Sun Xiaoming that it was the music played by her good friend Zhang Zhaohua, one of the most outstanding musicians of our time. Sun Xiaoming and Zhang Li enjoyed the beauty of azaleas and the melodious pipa music together, as if they were in a fairyland. They walked to the lake in the courtyard. There were several egrets floating on the lake. They danced and told a beautiful story to all things on the earth. This lake is called West Lake and is one of the most famous lakes in China. Sun Xiaoming and Zhang Li held hands and enjoyed the beautiful scenery of the lake together. Their hearts are closely connected, and they feel the power and beauty of nature with each other. In this spring courtyard, they jointly felt the importance of the ecological environment and deepened their feelings for each other.

10_3_0.content: Sun Xiaoming and Wang Ming are neighbors in the community. They often meet in the community and exchange ideas and experiences about environmental protection. One day, they talked about cases of social progress. One of the striking cases was the abolition of slavery in American history. Sun Xiaoming introduced to Wang Ming the origins and important figures of the abolition movement. He mentioned the ethical significance of the abolition movement and the tremendous changes it brought to society. Sun Xiaoming also shared some specific cases and works of the abolition movement, such as Thomas Jefferson's criticism of the slavery system in the Declaration of Independence, Frederick Douglass's autobiography 'The Slave Narrative', etc. Together they explored how the abolition movement affected social progress and inspired a series of progressive movements such as the civil rights movement. This exchange gave Sun Xiaoming and Wang Ming a deeper understanding of the history and significance of the abolition movement, and also enhanced their thinking on social progress.
10_3_0.summary: Exchange topics about the abolition movement

Wang Ming introduced them to some common problems in marriage and provided methods and techniques to solve them. He encourages them to communicate actively and maintain good interaction and understanding. Wang Ming also shared some cases of successful marriages, allowing them to draw experience and inspiration from them. Zhang Hao and Li Fang are very grateful for Wang Ming's professional advice, which they believe will have a positive impact on their married life.

Especially the solo dance 'Flying Notes', Emily's outstanding performance as a dancer amazed them. After the performance, Sun Xiaoming and Wang Ming continued to discuss the highlights and creativity of dance outside the theater. They admired choreographer John Smith's talent and unique understanding of music and dance. This experience of watching 'Dance of Music' enhanced the friendship between Sun Xiaoming and Wang Ming, and also brought them an unforgettable cultural and artistic experience.

This project has received support and recognition from the school and attracted the participation and attention of many students. Through their efforts, Sun Xiaoming and Yang Lin have successfully raised students' awareness of environmental protection and cultivated a group of young people who care about ecological issues. Their collaboration has been considered Jayne Goodell-esque, setting an example for ecological education.

Sun Xiaoming and Yang Lin spent a pleasant time together in this Spring Festival celebration, enhanced their friendship, and also felt the unique charm of traditional Chinese festivals.

Zhou Ting.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Zhou Ting**

Zhou Ting, affectionately known as Tingting, is a 30-year-old hotel management expert from China. With her elegant temperament and a perpetual smile, she exudes professionalism and warmth, making her a distinguished figure in the hospitality industry. Her long hair adds a touch of grace to her persona, perfectly complementing her Asian heritage.

As a hotel manager for a renowned hotel group, Tingting has demonstrated exceptional leadership and strategic acumen. Her career is marked by the successful management of multiple prestigious hotels, where she significantly improved customer satisfaction and overall performance. Her dedication and skill earned her the Best Hotel Manager Award, a testament to her excellence and commitment to the industry.

Tingting's passion for travel, reading, and tasting diverse cuisines fuels her creativity and understanding of global hospitality trends. Her educational background in hotel management provided her with a solid foundation, enabling her to innovate and adapt in a rapidly evolving field.

Inspired by the legendary Li Ka-shing, Zhou Ting aspires to embody his entrepreneurial spirit and philanthropy. Her story is one of ambition, achievement, and elegance, making her a respected role model for aspiring professionals in the hospitality sector.

Zhu Xiaolong.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Zhu Xiaolong**

Zhu Xiaolong, affectionately known as Xiaolong, is a 30-year-old electrical engineer from China, known for his remarkable contributions to the field of electrical engineering. With a medium build, black hair, and dark eyes, Xiaolong possesses a captivating presence that complements his intellectual prowess.

As an accomplished engineer, Xiaolong works for a prominent power company, where he applies his extensive expertise in electrical engineering to drive innovation and efficiency in energy projects. His passion for technology and problem-solving is reflected in the outstanding achievement awards he has garnered for his work, showcasing his dedication and skill.

Educated in electrical engineering, Xiaolong has gained a reputation for excellence, exemplified by his triumph in the National Electric Power Engineering Design Competition, where he secured first prize. This achievement is a testament to his innovative spirit and dedication to advancing the field.

Beyond his professional endeavors, Xiaolong enjoys a balanced lifestyle with hobbies such as reading, programming, and engaging in outdoor sports. His admiration for Nikola Tesla as a role model fuels his ambition to innovate and contribute positively to the engineering world. Through his work, Zhu Xiaolong continues to inspire those around him and champion progress in electrical engineering.

12_2_2.content: In 2018, Zhu Xiaolong’s girlfriend Wang Lu noticed that a company exaggerated the efficacy of its products in advertising, claiming that it could cure a certain disease. This caught the attention of Wang Lu and other consumers because the disease is a common and difficult-to-treat condition. Wang Lu decided to file a lawsuit against the company for its false propaganda and reported it to the relevant departments. She believes the company's actions violated China's Anti-Unfair Competition Law. According to the provisions of this law, companies will face severe penalties if they make false claims in advertisements, promotional materials or product packaging, mislead consumers, or maliciously slander the reputation of competitors. Wang Lu's report attracted the attention of relevant departments, who launched an investigation into the company and confirmed the facts of its false propaganda. As a whistleblower, Wang Lu actively cooperated with the investigation and provided relevant evidence. In the end, the company was fined 5 million yuan and ordered to immediately stop false advertising. At the same time, the company was required to publicly apologize and return illegal gains obtained from false propaganda. Wang Lu's reporting behavior has been recognized, and she has made positive contributions to maintaining market order and fair competition.

He told Zhang Hua that the VRV system is a variable frequency air conditioning system developed by Dajin Industry, which can intelligently control indoor temperature and achieve efficient heating and cooling. Radiant floor heating systems transfer heat through the floor to provide even indoor temperature distribution. The air purification system can remove particulate matter, formaldehyde and harmful gases in indoor air, providing a fresh and healthy indoor environment. Zhu Xiaolong also shared the team’s experience and results in the project, as well as his personal expertise in electrical engineering. Zhang Hua listened with great interest and expressed his great admiration for Zhu Xiaolong's work and professional abilities. Zhu Xiaolong was very interested in the history of Rome, and he shared some knowledge about the Colosseum with Zhang Hua. He told Zhang Hua that the Colosseum was built between 70 and 80 AD and was a place for gladiator competitions and beast fights in ancient Rome. Together they visited various parts of the Colosseum, from the animal cages underground, to the seats above ground, to the corridors on the upper floors. Zhu Xiaolong explained to Zhang Hua the architectural features of the Colosseum, such as the three-story arched columns on the facade and 80 arches on each floor. They also learned that the seats in the Colosseum were divided into different classes, for emperors, nobles and ordinary people. Zhu Xiaolong also introduced to Zhang Hua the competitive performances in the Colosseum, including gladiator competitions, carriage races and fights between beasts and humans. They walked around the Colosseum and imagined the life scenes of ancient Romans. Both Zhu Xiaolong and Zhang Hua were deeply attracted by the magnificent scenery and long history of the Colosseum, and they took many photos as souvenirs. After the visit, they rested together in a nearby cafe, tasted local food, and talked about their feelings about Rome and the importance of cultural exchanges. This visit enabled Zhu Xiaolong and Zhang Hua to better understand the history and culture of ancient Rome, and also deepened their friendship.

**Protagonist: Xu Hui**

Xu Hui, fondly known as Huihui, is a dynamic Media and Communication Research Specialist hailing from China. At 30, she has already established herself as a prominent figure in her field through her groundbreaking work in media studies. With her long hair, bright smile, and captivating eyes, Huihui carries an aura of approachability and intelligence.

Her career as a researcher is marked by her deep commitment to understanding the evolving dynamics of media. Xu Hui's passion for reading and writing complements her professional endeavors, allowing her to produce insightful academic papers that have earned her recognition, including the prestigious Outstanding Paper Award. Her love for photography also provides a creative outlet, which she often uses to capture moments that resonate with her research themes.

Having participated in both domestic and international media research projects, Xu Hui has made significant contributions to her field. She draws inspiration from pioneers in media studies, aspiring to further their legacy through her innovative approaches. Educated in Media and Media Studies, Xu Hui works at a research institute where she leverages her knowledge to advance communication research. Her dedication and achievements highlight her as a leading scholar in the Asian media landscape, with a promising future ahead.

13_1_1.content: Xu Hui and Li Li talked about the latest chromosome research progress at a party. Xu Hui shared her recent research case on human cancer genome. She explained to Li Li that researchers use high-resolution chromosome conformation capture technology to explore the relationship between the three-dimensional structure of chromosomes and cancer development. Xu Hui introduced in detail the researchers' experimental process, which included collecting tumor cell samples from patients with different types of cancer and labeling chromosomes using fluorescence in situ hybridization technology to visualize the location and structure of chromosomes. She also mentioned the application of Hi-C technology, which is a technology that can analyze the spatial structure of chromosomes in the nucleus. Xu Hui told Li Li that through Hi-C technology, researchers can obtain a three-dimensional chromosome structure map of the entire genome, and have discovered chromosome structural abnormalities in certain cancer types during the research process. She cited breast cancer as an example, pointing out that in breast cancer, some key gene regions on chromosomes become closer to each other, which may lead to overexpression or mutation of genes. In addition, she also mentioned the existence of chromosomal rearrangements in cancer cells, which may affect gene expression and regulation. Xu Hui and Li Li were shocked by these findings and discussed the importance of chromosome research in the field of cancer and the new ideas and targets it provides for cancer prevention and treatment. They all believed that this research was of great significance in promoting the development of cancer treatment and expressed their expectation for future research progress.

13_5_2.content: In a robbery case that occurred somewhere, the defendant Li Ming was charged with robbery. On the day of the incident, Li Ming entered a jewelry store at around 2 p.m. and threatened the clerk Wang Xiaomei to hand over the jewelry. Li Ming held a knife and threatened Wang Xiaomei that she must obey his orders, otherwise she would be harmed. Wang Xiaomei handed over jewelry worth 1 million yuan out of concern for her personal safety. The case attracted the attention of local police, who immediately launched an investigation. Through surveillance video, witness testimony and other evidence, investigators confirmed the fact that Li Ming entered the jewelry store on the day of the incident and threatened the clerk with a weapon. The police also discovered through the investigation of Li Ming that he had recorded multiple similar robberies before, and traces of him were also found in the surveillance video around the day of the incident. Based on the above evidence, the public prosecution agency prosecuted Li Ming for robbery. During the trial stage, the court heard the case in accordance with the law. Li Ming's defense lawyer presented his not guilty plea, claiming that Li Ming's facial features could not be clearly identified in the surveillance video and questioned the authenticity of the witness's testimony. However, the prosecution successfully rebutted the defense attorney's challenge by showing the testimony of multiple witnesses and the clarity of surveillance video. After a court hearing, the judge found Li Ming guilty of robbery and, in accordance with Article 263 of the Criminal Law, sentenced Li Ming to ten years in prison and fined him 50,000 yuan. This sentence aims to maintain social fairness and justice and serve as a warning to other potential criminals.

13_6_0.content: Xu Hui is carefully reading papers on information entropy theory in her laboratory, preparing to participate in an international academic conference. At this time, she heard Mr. Wang knocking on the door next to her. Mr. Wang is a friendly middle-aged neighbor who often communicates and shares their interests with Xu Hui. After Xu Hui opened the door, Mr. Wang saw the paper in Xu Hui's hand and asked curiously. Xu Hui enthusiastically explained the importance and application of information entropy theory to Mr. Wang. They sat together in Xu Hui's research room and discussed Shannon's information entropy theory in depth. Xu Hui gave Mr. Wang a simple example and explained how to use information entropy to quantify and transmit information. They discussed concepts such as information entropy, conditional entropy, relative entropy, and mutual information, and explored the applications of these concepts in the fields of communication and data processing. Xu Hui also mentioned the importance of information entropy theory in cryptography and its role in designing and analyzing encryption algorithms. This discussion gave Mr. Wang a deeper understanding of the information entropy theory and enhanced their friendship.

13_6_2.content: One sunny afternoon, Xu Hui and her friendly middle-aged neighbor Mr. Wang met by chance in the garden of the community. They have always maintained a friendly neighborly relationship and often communicate and share each other's interests in their free time. On this day, Xu Hui had just finished participating in an academic seminar on media and media research, and she was feeling particularly excited. She mentioned her interest in Christian history to Mr. Wang and shared relevant deeds of Constantine the Great, the founder of the Byzantine Empire. Xu Hui vividly described to Mr. Wang the important influence of Emperor Constantine on the development of Christianity in the early 4th century AD. She mentioned Emperor Constantine's victory over his rival Maximian at the Battle of the Milvian Bridge in 312 AD, making him the sole ruler of the Roman Empire. She also told Mr. Wang that in 313 AD, Emperor Constantine signed the Edict of Milan, declaring Christianity legal and giving them the right to practice freely. This move broke the Roman Empire's persecution of Christianity and marked the official recognition of Christianity's status in the Roman Empire. Xu Hui went on to talk about the Council of Nicaea hosted by Emperor Constantine in 325 AD, which was one of the most important councils in Christian history. She explained to Mr. Wang the importance of the Council of Nicaea and mentioned that Emperor Constantine promoted the formulation of the Nicene Creed, which stipulates Christian doctrine and belief principles. The Nicene Creed became the cornerstone of Christian orthodoxy and played an important guiding role in the subsequent development of Christianity. Xu Hui also introduced to Mr. Wang the historical background of Emperor Constantine’s move of the capital to the newly built Constantinople. She mentioned that Constantinople is world-famous for its magnificent architecture and rich cultural heritage, especially the Hagia Sophia, which was built under the orders of Emperor Constantine and is considered one of the masterpieces of Byzantine architecture. Xu Hui shared this knowledge with Mr. Wang with great interest, and Mr. Wang listened attentively. He deeply admired Xu Hui's enthusiasm and rich knowledge, and expressed appreciation for her career development and academic achievements. This exchange brought them closer and deepened their friendship.

Madan.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Madan**

Nickname: Dandan  
Gender: Male  
Age: 32  
Nationality: Chinese  
Ethnic Background: Asian  

**Professional Overview:**
Madan, affectionately known as Dandan, is a distinguished soil scientist, contributing to the field with his expertise and passion. Holding a position at the Soil Science Institute of a prestigious university, Madan has dedicated his career to unraveling the complexities of soil ecosystems. His academic journey in soil science has been marked by numerous achievements, including the publication of multiple research papers that have advanced understanding in his field. He has actively participated in various projects aimed at soil ecosystem protection, showcasing his commitment to environmental preservation.

**Physical Characteristics:**
Tall and distinguished by his black hair and dark brown eyes, Madan presents a striking presence in both academic and professional circles.

**Personal Interests:**
Beyond his professional pursuits, Madan is an avid traveler and reader. These hobbies complement his scientific endeavors, allowing him to explore diverse landscapes and cultures, enriching his understanding of global soil diversity.

**Recognition and Inspiration:**
Madan's contributions to soil science have been recognized with the Outstanding Young Scientist Award. He draws inspiration from his role model, Teacher Li Xian, whose guidance has been instrumental in shaping his career and values.

Madan embodies dedication to both science and the environment, making significant strides in protecting our planet's vital ecosystems.

15_0_0.content: Madan, as a renowned soil scientist, was invited to speak at the 'Global Environmental Conference'. The event was held at a large convention center, attracting attention from environmentalists and media from all over the world. Jack Ma, Dandan's brother, attended the event as a special guest. Madan delivered a keynote speech focusing on soil ecosystem protection and its impact on sustainable agricultural development. He shared insights from his research and projects, discussing the innovative methods used in soil conservation. Jack Ma expressed admiration for Madan's dedication to soil science and his efforts in environmental protection. After the conference, they held a private dinner to celebrate the successful event, discussing their future contributions to sustainable practices in agriculture and environmental protection.

15_0_1.content: Ma Dan and Ma Yun are brothers and they have a deep family relationship. On June 10, 2021, Ma Dan invited Jack Ma to visit the agricultural company he runs. The agricultural company is jointly run by Ma Dan and Ma Yun, who are committed to promoting sustainable agricultural development and soil ecosystem protection. As a soil scientist, Madan has in-depth research and understanding of soil protection and utilization. He hopes to contribute to agricultural development through his own efforts. As Ma Dan’s brother and partner, Ma Yun has an in-depth understanding of and participation in the operation and development of agricultural companies. During the visit to the agricultural company, Ma Dan introduced the company's operations, research projects and results to Ma Yun. Together they visited farmlands, greenhouses and laboratories and learned about the company's innovations in agricultural technology, fertilizer utilization and soil protection. Jack Ma expressed his appreciation for the achievements and development of agricultural companies and said that he will continue to support and promote the cause of sustainable agricultural development. The cooperation between Ma Dan and Jack Ma is not only the friendship between brothers, but also the efforts for common goals and ideals. They hope to make greater contributions to agricultural development and soil ecosystem protection through their efforts.
15_0_1.Theme: Ma Dan and Jack Ma visit agricultural companies

15_1_0.content: In 2010, Ma Dan's college roommate Zhang Wei, an agricultural scientist, invited Ma Dan to visit an art exhibition about 'The Last Supper'. The exhibition was held in a large art gallery and attracted the attention of many art lovers and cultural scholars. Zhang Wei knew that Ma Dan had a strong interest in art, so he specially invited him to go with him. Together they admired the magnificent scene of this mural and were deeply impressed by Leonardo da Vinci's painting skills and artistic conception. During the exhibition, Ma Dan explained the historical background and significance of 'The Last Supper' to Zhang Wei, and shared some interesting details about the work. After the exhibition, they also discussed the impact of their works on the humanities and social fields, and exchanged their unique insights on art. This exhibition became an opportunity for more in-depth communication between Ma Dan and Zhang Wei, deepening their friendship.

15_1_1.content: Ma Dan and his college roommate Zhang Wei decided to participate in the Tomb Sweeping Festival rituals held on the ancient canal in Hangzhou. They got up early in the morning, prepared flowers and offerings, and headed to the dock of the ancient canal. As soon as they arrived at the pier, they saw a huge crowd of people, and tourists boarded the boats to perform sacrificial rituals. On the ship, there are various folk performances and folk artists show off their talents. Ma Dan and Zhang Wei walked along the deck of the ship and enjoyed traditional dragon dance, lion dance and other performances. They held flowers in their hands and threw bouquets into the river to express their thoughts and respect for their deceased relatives. At the same time, they also observed many people holding bouquets of chrysanthemums, peach blossoms, jasmine and other flowers to participate in the sacrificial ceremony. Ma Dan and Zhang Wei also deeply felt the cultural connotation of Chinese traditional festivals and people's affectionate expressions for their loved ones.
15_1_1.summary: Participate in ancient canal sacrificial activities

15_1_2.content: Ma Dan and Zhang Wei were college roommates and now work as soil scientists and agricultural scientists respectively. When Ma Dan decided to hold a wedding, he asked Zhang Wei for advice and help. Zhang Wei understood Ma Dan's preferences and requirements and recommended several suitable venues for weddings. In the end, Ma Dan and Zhang Li chose the banquet hall of a five-star hotel in Beijing as their wedding venue. Zhang Wei went to the hotel with them for inspection and had detailed communication with the hotel's banquet hall manager. They were impressed by the beautiful gardens and exquisite decoration of the banquet hall and determined the details of the banquet hall's use. Zhang Wei also helped them sign a contract with the hotel to ensure everything went smoothly. Thanks to Zhang Wei's help, Ma Dan and Zhang Li were able to find a luxurious and romantic wedding venue that added a unique charm to their wedding.
15_1_2.summary: Assistance in choosing a wedding venue

15_2_0.content: Dandan and Wang Li decided to spend a romantic weekend together. They chose a boutique cafe in the center of the city as their date spot. The atmosphere of the cafe is warm and cozy, with elegant decoration and soft music. Dandan reserved a window seat in advance to enjoy the beautiful view of the city. They ordered two cups of fragrant coffee and an exquisite dessert in the cafe. Sitting by the window, Dandan and Wang Li chatted about each other's work and research results while enjoying the aroma of coffee. They share with each other their love and concern for soil ecosystems. Dandan was deeply attracted to Wang Li's intelligence and passion for soil science. Their conversation was filled with laughter and mutual admiration. The taste of coffee and dessert slowly spread on their tongues, giving them a feeling of sweetness and happiness. After the pleasant coffee time, Dandan took Wang Li for a walk in a nearby park. The sun shone on the two of them, and the breeze blew across their faces. They walked hand in hand along the paths in the park, admiring the surrounding flowers and trees. Dandan and Wang Li stopped from time to time to listen to the singing of birds and the rustling of leaves. They feel the beauty and tranquility of nature together, and share each other's joy and happiness. In the evening, Dandan and Wang Li found a cozy small restaurant and enjoyed an exquisite dinner. While enjoying the delicious food, they talked about their future plans and dreams. Dandan is grateful to Wang Li for her support and understanding in her career. They encourage and motivate each other. This romantic date strengthened Dandan and Wang Li's feelings for each other and their future direction. They decided to continue working hard, contribute to the research and protection of soil science, and experience more good times together.
15_2_0.Theme: Dandan and Wang Li’s romantic date

15_2_1.content: Ma Dan (Dandan) and his girlfriend Wang Li are a romantic couple. They recently participated in the International Soil Science Congress on June 10, 2022. This conference is an important event in the global soil science community, bringing together soil scientists and experts from all over the world. As outstanding representatives in the field of soil science, Ma Dan and Wang Li were invited to attend the conference as guests and published research results on soil ecosystem protection. During the meeting, they had in-depth exchanges with soil scientists from other countries and shared each other's research results and experiences. In addition to academic exchanges, Ma Dan and Wang Li also participated in social activities and dinners organized by the conference. During the break during the meeting, they also explored the scenic spots at the venue and felt the local culture and customs. This romantic trip not only enriched their knowledge and academic insights, but also enhanced their feelings and tacit understanding. After returning to China, Ma Dan and Wang Li will continue to work together on soil science research and plan to carry out more soil ecosystem protection projects to make greater contributions to protecting the earth's soil resources.
15_2_1.summary: Attend the International Soil Science Congress together
15_2_1.Theme: Dandan and Wang Li's romantic journey

15_3_0.content: Ma Dan met his colleague Liu Ming by chance at an academic conference. Liu Ming is a young and promising soil scientist who focuses on the study of soil ecosystems. Ma Dan and Liu Ming are colleagues at the Soil Science Institute of the same university, and they have had some cooperation and exchanges in their work. During the meeting, Liu Ming introduced his latest soil research project to Ma Dan. This project is about soil ecosystem protection. Liu Ming hopes to explore sustainable soil management methods by studying the ecological functions of microorganisms in the soil. Ma Dan expressed strong interest in Liu Ming's research project and provided him with some suggestions and opinions. The two had in-depth discussions during the meeting and exchanged each other's research results and experiences. This unexpected encounter gave Ma Dan a deeper understanding of Liu Ming's research project and deepened their cooperative relationship.

15_3_1.content: Ma Dan participated in an international soil academic conference on March 15, 2022, and communicated with his acquaintance Liu Ming during the conference. Liu Ming is an excellent soil scientist, and they were classmates in college. During the coffee break of the meeting, Ma Dan and Liu Ming chatted about their respective research results. Madan shared his latest research papers on soil science and the soil ecosystem protection projects he participated in. Liu Ming expressed his appreciation for Ma Dan's achievements and asked him some questions about soil ecosystems. They exchanged views on the research and protection of soil ecosystems, and shared their thoughts and experiences. This exchange made Ma Dan very happy. He believed that exchanges with colleagues like Liu Ming can learn from and improve each other, and at the same time enhance their friendship.
15_3_1.summary: Discuss research results on soil ecosystems

15_4_0.content: Ma Dan and Li Jing are colleagues from the Institute of Soil Science. They collaborated on a soil pollution control project on May 12, 2021. This project is a soil protection project they recently participated in, aiming to explore the causes and treatment methods of soil pollution. As a soil scientist, Ma Dan focuses on studying soil ecosystems, while Li Jing is a soil pollution expert and is good at analyzing and controlling soil pollution. They cooperate very closely, learn from each other and exchange experiences, and work together to solve the problem of soil pollution. In this project, Madan is responsible for collecting soil samples and conducting soil quality analysis, while Li Jing is responsible for formulating treatment plans and evaluating treatment effects. Through their collaborative efforts, they successfully proposed an effective soil pollution control program and promoted it within the institute. Their work has been highly praised by their colleagues and they have made positive contributions to the cause of soil protection.
15_4_0.summary: Collaborative research on soil pollution control

15_4_1.content: Among the institute's partners, Ma Dan and his colleague Li Jing are involved in a project called 'Soil Ecosystem Protection and Restoration.' This project aims to study soil ecosystem restoration and protection methods to reduce soil degradation and improve the sustainable use of farmland. As a soil scientist, Ma Dan is responsible for the collection and analysis of soil samples in the project, while Li Jing is responsible for the research and analysis of soil microbial communities. They work closely together, exchange research results with each other, and jointly promote the progress of the project. They meet regularly to discuss research progress and share their research results and findings with each other. During the project, Ma Dan and Li Jing established a good working relationship. They supported and collaborated with each other and worked together to promote soil ecosystem protection. Together they have published several research papers and have received recognition and appreciation from their peers. In addition to cooperation at work, Ma Dan and Li Jing have also become good friends. They often discuss topics in work and life together, and share each other's preferences and interests. With their efforts, the 'Soil Ecosystem Protection and Restoration' project has achieved certain results and made a positive contribution to soil protection and sustainable agricultural development.

15_4_2.content: Ma Dan and Li Jing are colleagues from the Institute of Soil Science. On June 15, 2022, they jointly participated in an important soil protection project.

15_5_0.content: As a student, Ma Dan was invited to participate in the tea tasting party held by Li Xian. This tasting aims to introduce and promote China's unique tea culture. One of the most recommended teas is 'Longjing Charm'.

15_5_1.content: As a student of Li Xian, Ma Dan is deeply concerned about the ethnic split in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. At an academic seminar, Ma Dan proposed to Li Xian a research plan on the issue of ethnic divisions in Xinjiang. Madan hopes to provide a scientific basis for solving this problem by studying the role of soil ecosystems in social stability and national harmony. Li Xian was full of interest in Ma Dan's research and encouraged him to explore this topic in depth. Li Xian provided a large amount of academic resources and guidance to help Ma Dan formulate research methods and design experimental plans. He also participated in a number of soil ecosystem protection projects with Madan, making practical contributions to solving the issue of ethnic divisions in Xinjiang. Li Xian played an important guiding role in Ma Dan's research work, not only helping him achieve academic breakthroughs, but also cultivating his research interests and sense of social responsibility. Ma Dan is well aware that Li Xian's help and guidance have had a profound impact on him, and will continue to work hard to solve the problem of national divisions in the field of soil science.
15_5_1.Theme: The issue of ethnic separatism in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

15_5_2.content: As Dandan’s mentor, Li Xian provided him with valuable guidance and support, enabling him to participate in the COVID-19 vaccination program.
15_5_2.summary: Guiding Dandan to participate in the new crown vaccination plan

15_6_0.content: On March 15, 2021, Wang Ming, Madan’s neighbor as a soil scientist, approached him for help. Wang Ming is a farm operator. He recently discovered that the soil quality of his farmland has declined, and crop yields have been greatly affected. Wang Ming was very confused about this and hoped that Ma Dan could provide professional opinions and solutions. Madan accepted Wang Ming's request and went to his farm for an on-site inspection. After detailed soil analysis and observation, Madan discovered that there were problems such as nutrient imbalance and low organic matter content in farmland soil. He had an in-depth exchange with Wang Ming and learned that Wang Ming had not carried out scientific and reasonable fertilization and soil management measures before. Based on his professional knowledge, Madan provided Wang Ming with a detailed soil improvement plan, including suggestions for rational fertilization, increasing organic matter content, and improving soil structure. Wang Ming was very grateful for Madan's help and decided to carry out farmland improvement work according to the plan provided by Madan. After a period of hard work, Wang Ming's farmland soil gradually improved, and crop yields also increased significantly. Beyond his professional achievements, Xiaoxin is an avid reader and writer. Driven by a commitment to excellence and innovation, Huang Xin continues to lead the way in educational statistics, inspiring peers and aspiring statisticians worldwide.

16_0_1.content: On June 15, 2022, Huang Ming, Huang Xin’s father, improved the stability of drone flight. Huang Ming is a drone enthusiast. He learned about the application of sliding mode control algorithm in drone flight and decided to introduce it into his own drone control system. He modeled the drone using an accurate dynamic model, taking into account factors such as the aircraft's dynamic characteristics, aerodynamic parameters, inertia matrix, and mass distribution. In order to enhance the robustness of the system, he also used an adaptive control strategy so that the control parameters can be automatically adjusted to adapt to the uncertainty of the system model. During the flight, Huang Ming's controller measures the drone's position, speed and attitude information in real time and compares it with the desired trajectory. According to the principle of sliding mode control algorithm, Huang Ming's controller achieves the stability and convergence of the system by introducing sliding mode surfaces. He also used a switching function as an activation function to determine the working mode of the system based on the measurement error of the drone and the slope of the sliding mode surface. By dynamically adjusting the parameters of the switching function, Huang Ming's sliding mode controller is able to achieve fast response, high robustness, and robust stability. Huang Ming's efforts and technical application have significantly improved the flight stability of his drone, which has brought more fun and challenges to his drone hobby. Huang Ming's exploration and practice are not only of great significance in the field of drones, but also provide valuable experience and reference for other fields that require stable and robust control, such as robot navigation, autonomous vehicles, etc.
16_0_1.summary: Huang Ming uses sliding mode control algorithm to improve UAV flight stability
