They have promoted the development of rural economy and improved the quality of life of farmers by conducting research, communicating with farmers and holding training activities. Fang Jun and Yang Tao work together to promote rural reform. They cooperate with each other, negotiate to solve problems, and work together to improve farmers' living conditions. They work closely with people from all walks of life in rural areas to formulate effective policies and measures to promote the development of the rural economy and increase farmers' income. Their efforts were recognized and appreciated by farmers, and Fang Jun won the Agricultural Innovation Award and became Yang Baixun's role model for rural reform.
59_4_2.Theme: The relationship between Fang Jun and Yang Tao’s colleagues working in the Agricultural Bureau

59_5_0.content: In May 2020, Fang Jun, as a rural management expert, undertook a rural reform project aimed at improving farmers' quality of life and rural economic development. As Fang Jun’s mentor, Liu Feng, who was once a famous rural management expert, also participated in this project. Liu Feng has rich experience and professional knowledge and enjoys a high reputation in the field of rural management. He played an important role in the guidance and training of the Fang Army. Liu Feng and Fang Jun worked together to formulate a reform plan, including planting crops, raising livestock and communicating with farmers. They jointly discussed and studied how to improve farmers' agricultural production technology and management level. Liu Feng followed Yang Baixun as an example and inspired Fang Jun to study hard and achieve better results. During the project implementation, Liu Feng helped Fang Jun solve a series of problems through regular guidance and evaluation, and gave positive feedback and suggestions. Their cooperation has led to significant achievements in rural management projects, which not only improved the quality of life of farmers, but also enhanced the development level of the rural economy. The relationship between Liu Feng and Fang Jun is not only the relationship between mentor and student, but also the deep friendship between master and disciple. Through joint efforts, they have made positive contributions to rural management.
59_5_0.summary: Liu Feng participated in Fang Jun’s rural management project
59_5_0.Theme: Specific cases in the field of rural management

59_5_1.content: During the Ebola epidemic in 2014, Liu Feng participated in the epidemic tracking work of the HealthMap project. Liu Feng learned the use of the HealthMap system and data analysis skills through his professional experience and expertise. Liu Feng used machine learning algorithms and methods of mining named entity information in the HealthMap system to help professionals quickly understand the severity and spread of the epidemic. By searching for specific keywords and analyzing the collected data, he provides policymakers and disease prevention and control experts with timely epidemic warnings and predictions of transmission paths. Liu Feng's work provided important decision-making support for epidemic prevention and control and played an active role in the success of the project.
59_5_1.summary: Epidemic tracking during the Ebola epidemic

59_5_2.content: Fang Jun's mentor Liu Feng is a well-known rural management expert who has made outstanding achievements in the field of rural management. As a student of Liu Feng, Fang Jun received his guidance and training. In the development of China's social insurance system, Fang Jun and Liu Feng collaborated in the construction of social security informatization. They are committed to promoting the application of digitalization and Internet technology in social security services to improve the convenience and efficiency of services. They cooperated with government departments, technical teams and social security institutions to jointly research and develop the electronic social security card system and realize the national interconnection of social security information. Through this system, insured persons can directly use electronic social security cards to settle medical expenses when seeking medical treatment in various places, which is convenient and fast. They also put forward some innovative ideas and suggestions, such as promoting the onlineization of social security services and carrying out big data analysis of social security data, making positive contributions to the sustainable development of the social security system. Their work has been recognized and appreciated by social security institutions and insured persons, and they have made important contributions to the construction of China's social insurance system.
59_5_2.summary: Participate in the construction of social security informatization

59_6_0.content: Fang Jun's neighbor Zhao Li is a farmer who loves art and has expressed a strong interest in the copyright dispute of the famous painting 'Mona Lisa' by the famous painter Leonardo da Vinci. They often discussed art and design topics during breaks in the fields, including the Mona Lisa copyright dispute. Zhao Li believes that as an undisputed art treasure, this painting should continue to enjoy legal protection to prevent piracy and unfair commercial exploitation. He paid attention to the controversial bill proposed by the French authorities to extend the copyright protection period, and believed that this was a protection of the rights of artistic creators. However, Fang Jun holds a different view. He believes that after the copyright expires, the work should completely enter the public domain, so that more people can freely appreciate and use the work. These discussions not only allowed them to deepen their understanding of the balance and controversies between art and copyright protection, but also added new topics and interactions to their friendship.

59_6_1.content: Fang Jun and Zhao Li are neighbors and they share a love of local community sports. On the day of a significant local soccer tournament final, Fang Jun invited Zhao Li to watch the competition together. They arrived at the local stadium with great interest and sat among the spectators, looking forward to supporting their community team. Zhao Li didn’t know much about soccer, but she appreciated Fang Jun’s enthusiasm and decided to fully support their local team. During the match, Zhao Li was amazed by the competitive spirit and teamwork displayed by the players. She was drawn in by the excitement of the game and cheered enthusiastically. When the local team won, Zhao Li and Fang Jun celebrated together, enjoying the community spirit and camaraderie. This event deepened Zhao Li's interest in local sports and highlighted Fang Jun's diverse interests as a rural management expert.

59_6_2.content: On June 15, 2022, Fang Jun, as a rural management expert, launched a coral reef protection activity. He invited his neighbor Zhao Li to participate and introduced her to the importance of the Great Barrier Reef and the threats it faced. Zhao Li expressed concern about this and expressed her willingness to contribute her share to protecting the coral reef ecosystem. During the event, Fang Jun and Zhao Li visited the islands of the Great Barrier Reef and watched the coral reef protection projects displayed by the research center. They learned about the harm global warming and human activities are causing to coral reefs. Zhao Li decided to take action, and she and Fang Jun participated in a coral reef cleanup event to help remove garbage and pollutants around the island. They also participated in coral reef tree planting activities and planted some corals adapted to the local environment. These measures aim to increase the stability and ecological diversity of coral reefs. Zhao Li deeply understands the importance of protecting the Great Barrier Reef, and she decided to pass on these experiences and knowledge to people around her to increase public awareness of coral reef protection. Through the efforts of Fang Jun and Zhao Li, more people began to pay attention to and participate in the protection of the Great Barrier Reef and contribute to the future of the coral reef.
59_6_2.summary: Zhao Li participated in the coral reef protection activities organized by Fang Jun

59_7_0.content: As a member of the village committee, Fang Jun and Chen Qiang participated in community discussions on fashion trends. Fang Jun expressed his strong interest in the creative and personalized design elements of the Gucci autumn and winter series 2022. He praised the collection’s mix of materials and textures, as well as its attention to detail. Fang Jun believes that this kind of layered and textured design can attract the attention of the fashion industry and young people and promote the development of fashion trends. He and Chen Qiang discussed the unique decorative details in this series, such as embroidery, sequins and leather decoration, as well as the rich colors and printing elements. Fang Jun also mentioned Gucci's focus on sustainable development and environmental protection, and expressed his appreciation for their use of sustainable materials and processes, as well as their emphasis on recycling. This discussion allowed community members to better understand the latest trends in the fashion industry, and also triggered everyone's thinking and discussion on fashion and sustainable development.
59_7_0.summary: Discussion about Gucci Autumn and Winter Series 2022

59_7_1.content: Among the members of the village committee of Fang Jun's village, Chen Qiang is an active community member. He and Fang Jun participated in the village's development plan. On May 10, 2019, Fang Jun hosted a meeting on the village development plan, and Chen Qiang participated as a representative of the community. At the meeting, Fang Jun introduced a plan to improve village infrastructure and improve the quality of life of farmers. Chen Qiang spoke actively at the meeting and put forward some constructive opinions and suggestions, such as paying attention to environmental protection in village construction and improving farmland irrigation systems. Fang Jun attached great importance to Chen Qiang's suggestions and incorporated them into the village development plan. Chen Qiang also expressed his willingness to actively participate in the implementation of the plan and contribute to the development of the village. In the following months, community members such as Fang Jun and Chen Qiang worked together to successfully implement the village development plan by raising funds, organizing volunteers, etc., significantly improving the village's infrastructure and improving the living conditions of farmers. Got promoted. Fang Jun and Chen Qiang established a good cooperative relationship in the process and became the driving force for village development.

59_8_1.content: Fang Jun met Liu Fang by chance on the train on his way to attend a seminar on the integrated development strategy of the Yangtze River Delta. Liu Fang is a young woman from Jiangsu Province who is very interested in the implementation of the Yangtze River Delta integrated development strategy. They started a friendly conversation, sharing their views and expectations for the strategy. Fang Jun introduced to Liu Fang his background as a rural management expert and his experience in participating in the strategy. Liu Fang shared her experience in promoting rural development in Jiangsu Province. The two gradually established common interests and goals, decided to keep in touch in future exchanges, and discussed how to further promote the integration of rural development and the Yangtze River Delta integrated development strategy. They exchanged contact information and agreed on a time and place for their next meeting.
59_8_1.summary: Fang Jun met Liu Fang during a business trip

Jiang Yan.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Jiang Yan**

Jiang Yan, affectionately known as Xiaoyan, is a distinguished 32-year-old geographer hailing from China. With a passion for unravelling the mysteries of the Earth, she has established herself as a prominent professor of geography at a renowned university. Tall and slender, with her long hair often cascading down her back, Jiang Yan exudes both elegance and intellect.

Her academic journey is marked by numerous accomplishments, including a prolific collection of published geography papers and significant contributions to various research projects. These achievements have earned her the prestigious Outstanding Young Scholar Award in her field. Jiang Yan's dedication to geography is inspired by her role model, the eminent geographer Wang Yang, whose legacy fuels her own aspirations.

Beyond academia, Xiaoyan is an avid traveler and photographer, capturing the essence of diverse landscapes and cultures through her lens. Her travels not only enrich her personal experiences but also enhance her professional expertise, allowing her to bring a unique global perspective into her classroom.

Jiang Yan's commitment to advancing geographical knowledge and her role as an educator make her a respected figure in her field, inspiring the next generation of geographers to explore and understand the world.

60_0_0.content: Yesterday, Jiang Yan and her sister Jiang Lin traveled to Suzhou together. Jiang Yan told Jiang Lin that there is a popular delicacy in Suzhou called Yangcheng Lake Hairy Crab Fried Rice, and they decided to try it together. Jiang Yan described the making process of fried rice in detail, mentioning that the fried rice uses local high-quality rice, paired with tender and juicy Yangcheng Lake hairy crab meat and fresh vegetables. Jiang Yan specially introduced the taste of hairy crabs and the unique flavor of fried rice to Jiang Lin, which made Jiang Lin look forward to this delicacy. So, they decided to try the unparalleled Yangcheng Lake hairy crab fried rice at a local restaurant. When the fried rice was served, Jiang Lin couldn't wait to take a bite. She praised: the rice is fragrant, glutinous but not sticky, and the crab meat is delicious and delicate. Every bite is full of deliciousness and surprises. Jiang Yan said with a smile that this is the perfect combination of Suzhou's traditional food and local high-quality aquatic resources. She recommended Jiang Lin to try it during her food tour in Suzhou, which will definitely bring her unparalleled enjoyment. While tasting the delicious food, the two sisters chatted about their travel experiences. The warm and pleasant time flowed through the streets of Suzhou.

60_1_0.content: Jiang Yan participated in a geographical research project on the impact of climate change on agriculture with her college friend Zhang Xiaoming. They jointly conducted in-depth research in the geography department of a university and jointly published a geography paper titled 'The Impact of Climate Change on Sustainable Agricultural Development' in the project. This paper explores the challenges of global climate change to agricultural production and possible solutions. Jiang Yan and Zhang Xiaoming jointly undertook a large amount of field research work during the project, including sampling and data collection in farmland in different regions of China. They also captured a large number of farmland scenes and related agricultural activities through drones. These field studies and data collection provided a solid scientific basis for their paper. During the research process, Jiang Yan and Zhang Xiaoming worked closely together to communicate and discuss the problems and findings in the research. They often study and discuss together in the laboratory, and also go out for field trips together. The cooperative relationship between Jiang Yan and Zhang Xiaoming is not limited to this project. They also often exchange their latest research results and opinions in the field of geography with each other. In addition to their academic collaboration, they are good friends, traveling and taking landscape photos together in their spare time. Jiang Yan likes to take a camera to record the beautiful moments during travel, while Zhang Xiaoming likes to capture the magnificent scenery of nature. They have visited many places in China together, including the unique peaks of Zhangjiajie and the landscape of the Li River in Guilin. Through travel and photography, Jiang Yan and Zhang Xiaoming deepened their friendship and understanding of each other.

60_1_1.content: As Jiang Yan’s university friend, Zhang Xiaoming participated in a geography research project and co-published a paper with Jiang Yan. While Jiang Yan was conducting geography research, Zhang Xiaoming suffered a traffic accident resulting in multiple fractures. After seeking medical treatment locally to no avail, he decided to transfer to a hospital for treatment. In view of the seriousness of Zhang Xiaoming's condition, he required surgical treatment. So, on November 5, 2019, Zhang Xiaoming underwent a five-hour operation performed by an orthopedic surgeon. During the operation, the doctor used advanced fracture reduction, internal fixation and bone graft material implantation techniques to ensure that the fracture site returned to its normal physiological structure. At the same time, in order to fix the fractured acetabulum, the doctor used external fixation and used steel plates and screws to fix the fracture. After the operation, doctors paid close attention to Zhang Xiaoming's incision healing and conducted regular reviews, including pain control and functional recovery. After about 3 months of treatment and rehabilitation exercises, Zhang Xiaoming's fracture successfully healed and he returned to normal daily activities.

60_1_2.content: Jiang Yan and Zhang Xiaoming were good friends in college. They participated in a geography research project together and successfully collaborated to publish a paper titled 'The Impact of Climate Change on Marine Ecosystems.' This paper conducts an in-depth study of the impact of global climate change on marine ecosystems and proposes related response strategies. Jiang Yan was responsible for the geography content of the paper, analyzing the impact of climate change on different marine ecosystems, and proposing relevant early warning indicators and protection suggestions. Zhang Xiaoming was responsible for the climatology content of the paper, studying the impact mechanism of climate change on the marine environment, and proposed corresponding models and prediction results. Through the joint efforts of Jiang Yan and Zhang Xiaoming, this paper attracted widespread attention in the field of international geography and was listed as one of the important research results of the international academic conference on geography in the same year.

60_3_2.content: With the cooperation of Jiang Yan and Wang Lei, they launched an interesting research project on the reproductive behavior of brown civets. They traveled to a forest and grassland area in southeastern Asia on May 12, 2021, which is the habitat of the brown civet. During this period, Jiang Yan and Wang Lei tracked, observed and recorded the behavior of wild brown civets to understand their communication and reproduction methods. They closely observed the calls of female brown civets and the reactions of males, and recorded their interactions. They found that during the breeding season of brown civets, competition between males is very fierce, and fierce fights often occur, including hair rubbing and minor wounds. Jiang Yan and Wang Lei also observed the nest selection behavior of female brown civets. They recorded how the females chose tree holes, dense forest bottoms, and dense vegetation as safe nests for their cubs. Through their research, they revealed communication patterns, reproductive behavior and survival strategies of the pups during brown civet reproduction. This research is of great significance for understanding the ecological habits of brown civets and protecting the reproduction and survival of this species.

**Protagonist: Guo Ming**

Ming's life is a colorful tapestry woven from threads of creativity and innovation, underscored by his notable achievements in design. With a robust educational background in design, Ming has carved a niche for himself in a competitive industry, contributing his talents to a prominent design company.

Renowned for his artistic versatility, Guo Ming has clinched multiple awards in various design competitions, a testament to his skill and dedication. His crowning achievement came when he won the gold medal in the national design competition, an accolade that cemented his status as a leading figure in his field. Inspired by the groundbreaking work of architect Zaha Hadid, Ming continuously seeks to push the boundaries of traditional design.

In his spare time, Ming indulges in painting and photography, capturing the world through his unique lens. His passion for travel fuels his creativity, providing endless inspiration for his work. Guo Ming's journey in the design world is a testament to his passion, dedication, and boundless creativity.

61_2_1.content: On a certain day of a certain month of a certain year, the Beijing Municipal People's Court made a judgment on an infringement dispute case involving advertising law. The plaintiff company is a well-known fashion brand 'Fashion Beauty', and the defendant company is an emerging e-commerce platform 'Shengshi Shopping'. The focus of the dispute in this case was an advertisement published by the defendant company that infringed on the trademark rights and reputation rights of the plaintiff company. During the trial of the case, the court found that the defendant company published an advertisement on its platform to attract consumers to purchase fashion products on its platform. The advertisement used the plaintiff's company's registered trademark 'Fashion Beauty' and its iconic products with high visibility. The defendant company used the trademark and product image of the plaintiff company in advertisements without the permission of the plaintiff company, which misled consumers and made them think that the plaintiff company was directly related to the defendant company. This not only damaged the trademark rights of the plaintiff company, but also seriously infringed on its reputation rights. The court found that the defendant company's behavior infringed on the plaintiff's trademark rights and reputation rights, and violated the provisions of the Advertising Law on advertising publishing. According to the provisions of the Advertising Law, others are not allowed to use others’ registered trademarks in advertisements without the permission of the right holder, and are not allowed to conduct false or misleading advertising. The court ruled in accordance with the law that the defendant company should compensate the plaintiff company for economic losses of 500,000 yuan, and bear corresponding legal responsibilities such as public apology. During the trial of this case, Guo Ming, as a designer, focuses on headwear design, and his girlfriend Li Xue has always given him firm support. As a partner who loves art and travel, Li Xue provided moral support to Guo Ming in court, and together with Guo Ming looked forward to justice being served. The trial and judgment of this case further consolidated my country's legal construction and legal practice in the field of advertising law, and promoted fair competition and the healthy development of the business environment. The court's resolute crackdown on advertising infringements provides companies with a fair and just market competition environment and protects consumers' rights to know and choose. The verdict of this case is of great significance for protecting trademark rights and interests, maintaining market order and consumer interests. It also serves as a strong warning to other infringing advertising publishers.

62_5_1.content: As Liu Min's mentor, Lian Tingting introduced a research case on the relationship between the transcription factor NF-κB and tumors at Tuesday's seminar. Lian Tingting explained the key role of NF-κB in inflammation, immune response, and cell proliferation and survival, as well as its correlation with the invasion and metastasis capabilities of cancer cells. She also described in detail the specific mechanism of the NF-κB signaling pathway after it is activated by growth factors such as tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α) and interleukin-1β (IL-1β). Lian Tingting particularly emphasized the importance of RNA interference technology in verifying this discovery, and pointed out that after inhibiting NF-κB expression, the proliferation and metastasis capabilities of breast cancer cells were significantly reduced. Liu Min became very interested in this research case. She actively participated in the discussion and raised some questions about experimental design and further research. Lian Tingting patiently answered Liu Min's questions and gave her some suggestions, encouraging her to study this field in depth and put forward her own research ideas. Chang Wei.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Chang Wei**

Chang Wei, affectionately known as Weiwei, stands as a distinguished human resources management expert, currently thriving as a human resources manager at a large multinational company. At 30 years of age, Wei embodies the spirit and professionalism of modern HR leadership, shaped by his comprehensive education background in Human Resources Management.

Hailing from China, Wei is of Asian descent and carries his heritage proudly into his global professional engagements. His medium build, complemented by short black hair and glasses, portrays an approachable yet assertive presence in the corporate arena.

Weiwei's passion for human resources extends beyond his workplace achievements, having won multiple awards, including the prestigious Outstanding Human Resources Professional Award from the Human Resources Association. He regards Jeff Bezos, the visionary founder of Amazon, as a pivotal role model, inspiring him to innovate and excel in his field.

Outside of work, Wei finds balance through his hobbies: reading, traveling, and maintaining fitness, all contributing to his holistic lifestyle. With a forward-thinking approach and commitment to excellence, Chang Wei continues to influence and lead with integrity in human resources management, shaping both his career and the future of HR practices globally.

63_0_1.content: Chang Wei has a close family relationship with his younger brother Li Ming. One day, Chang Wei and Li Ming were sitting in the study room at home, and they began to discuss biological evolution. Chang Wei mentioned the case of loris evolution observed by Darwin on the island of Madagascar. He described to Li Ming in detail the slow lorises' ability to evolve on dry grasslands and enter the dormant state of certain trees during seasons when food is scarce to reduce their need for nutrients. He also explained how the trees are called 'dormant trees' and make them an ideal place for slow lorises to spend the winter. Chang Wei told Li Ming that after millions of years of evolution, slow lorises have developed special hand and foot structures that enable them to flexibly climb tree trunks and shuttle between tree holes. He also mentioned that slow lorises have fur similar in color to tree bark to better blend into the environment. In addition, Chang Wei also introduced the changes in the food habits of slow lorises. With the help of symbiotic bacteria in the digestive tract, they can decompose cellulose and lignin in plant cell walls to obtain more nutrients. Chang Wei also told Li Ming that the slow lorises have formed a special relationship with some bees, and these bees have evolved the ability to collect nectar only from the slow lorises and live in symbiosis with the slow lorises. Li Ming was very interested in this case of biological evolution, and he and Chang Wei had an interesting and in-depth discussion.

**Protagonist: Jia Wei**

Jia Wei, fondly known by his nickname Mamoru, is a dedicated and influential figure in the realm of school management. At the age of 30, Jia Wei has carved a niche for himself, driven by a deep commitment to education and an unwavering passion for fostering academic excellence. He embodies a harmonious blend of traditional values and modern efficiency, reflecting his rich Asian heritage and educational background in school management.

With his distinctive black hair and dark eyes, Jia Wei possesses a commanding presence that belies his medium build. His leadership is characterized by strategic foresight and a hands-on approach, ensuring that the institutions under his care thrive and adapt to the evolving educational landscape.

Beyond his professional achievements, Jia Wei's personal interests paint a picture of a well-rounded individual. He finds solace in reading and the thrill of exploration through travel. His enthusiasm for playing table tennis adds a dynamic edge to his persona, highlighting his competitive spirit and dedication to continuous improvement.

Jia Wei's dedication has not gone unnoticed; his efforts were recognized when he won the School Management Advanced Individual Award, a testament to his exceptional contributions to the field. Praise and encouragement from school leaders further attest to his impact and potential.

His unwavering commitment to education, coupled with his diverse hobbies and achievements, make Jia Wei an inspiring figure in his community. As he continues to journey through the world of school management, Jia Wei remains a role model for many, embodying the values of perseverance, excellence, and holistic development.

Pei Li.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Pei Li**

Pei Li, affectionately known as Xiaoli, is a distinguished pathologist at the age of 30, hailing from China. With a medium build and long hair often worn with glasses, Pei Li exudes professionalism and dedication to her field. A passionate reader and avid traveler, Xiaoli finds joy in exploring new cultures and ideas, which often informs her work in pathology.

Her academic prowess is evident through her numerous published papers that delve into advanced topics within pathology. This has not only contributed to her reputation in the medical community but also led to her winning the prestigious Outstanding Youth Award in the medical field. Pei Li is inspired by Nobel Prize winner Lee Tsung-dao, whose groundbreaking work fuels her ambition and dedication to her profession.

Having completed her education in pathology, Xiaoli now serves as a vital member of a hospital's pathology department. Her contributions to the field are marked by her innovative approach and commitment to advancing medical knowledge. As Pei Li continues to build her career, she remains a role model for aspiring pathologists and an essential figure in the ongoing development of medical science. Her path is paved with curiosity, expertise, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

66_6_0.content: Pei Li noticed that her neighbor Liu Yang had symptoms of joint pain and swelling, and was diagnosed with atypical rheumatoid arthritis. Pei Li and Liu Yang conducted detailed pathological anatomy analysis to help Liu Yang understand the mechanism and scope of the disease. Through pathological section observation, it was found that Liu Yang's joint synovium had an obvious inflammatory reaction. The synovium was thickened and congested, and a large amount of serous fluid and inflammatory exudate accumulated, causing the joint cavity to expand. The proliferation of subsynovial fibrous tissue caused by the inflammatory reaction further leads to the degeneration of articular cartilage, which is manifested by the reduction of chondrocytes, damage to the cartilage matrix, and the gradual thinning and wear of the articular cartilage. In addition to joint damage, atypical rheumatoid arthritis can also affect other organ systems, such as the lungs and heart. Through immunohistochemistry analysis, Pei Li found that immunoglobulin deposition and T cell infiltration could be seen in the inflammatory lesions, indicating that the immune response plays an important role in the occurrence and development of the disease. Pei Li and Liu Yang jointly studied this case, helping Liu Yang better understand his disease, while also providing valuable data and observations for research in the medical community.
66_6_0.summary: Neighbor Liu Yang suffers from atypical rheumatoid arthritis
66_6_0.Theme: Pathological anatomy analysis of atypical rheumatoid arthritis

66_6_1.content: Pei Li and her neighbor Liu Yang met at a community event and began to discuss the Lebesgue measure, a classic case in measure theory. Pei Li introduced the concept and application fields of Lebesgue measure to Liu Yang, and especially mentioned the importance of Lebesgue measure in real variable function theory, probability theory and mathematical analysis. She gave an example that under the theoretical framework of Lebesgue measure, the measures of rational numbers and irrational numbers on the unit interval [0, 1] are equal, and the set C has the characteristic of measure 1. Liu Yang was interested in this case and had an in-depth discussion with Pei Li, exploring the Lebesgue measure's ability to accurately measure the size and properties of sets and its application value in mathematical research. This discussion allowed Pei Li and Liu Yang to better understand the importance of measure theory and deepened their common interest in the field of mathematics.

Chu Jie.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Chu Jie**

Chu Jie, affectionately known as Xiaojie, is a 30-year-old esteemed linguist from China, renowned for his remarkable contributions to the field of linguistics. Sporting a medium build, slight glasses, and short black hair, Chu Jie exudes an air of scholarly charm. His deep-rooted passion for languages is evident in his extensive research and numerous published papers, which have significantly influenced contemporary linguistic studies.

Educated in the field of linguistics, Chu Jie has established himself as a prominent figure within academic circles, frequently participating in international conferences where he shares his insights and discoveries with peers. His achievements have not gone unnoticed; he has been awarded for his outstanding research, further cementing his reputation as a leading expert. He draws inspiration from legendary linguist Noam Chomsky, striving to emulate Chomsky's groundbreaking work in his own career.

Currently employed at a university, Chu Jie balances his professional endeavors with personal passions, such as reading, writing, and traveling. These hobbies not only enrich his life but also inform his academic pursuits, providing him with fresh perspectives and ideas. Proud of his Han nationality heritage, Xiaojie continues to make strides in the world of linguistics, inspiring future generations of researchers.

67_3_1.content: Chu Jie and Zhang Wei occasionally walked together after dinner and exchanged trivial matters in life. On this day, they talked about China's monetary policy. Chu Jie explained to Zhang Wei China's 'walking on two legs' strategy, an economic policy first proposed by China in the 1980s. He told Zhang Wei that the purpose of this strategy is to balance the relationship between macro-control and market autonomy and promote economic development and stability. Chu Jie introduced in detail the measures taken by the central bank to implement this strategy, including targeted reserve requirement ratio cuts and reverse repurchase operations. He explained that the central bank guides the flow of funds to key areas and weak areas in the real economy by making differentiated adjustments to the deposit reserve ratios of different types of financial institutions. This can balance liquidity and avoid economic fluctuations caused by excessive looseness or tightness of monetary policy. In addition, Chu Jie also mentioned that the central bank uses reverse repurchase operations, that is, selling government bonds to withdraw liquidity, to affect the supply and demand relationship of market interest rates. He told Zhang Wei that by buying and selling treasury bonds, the central bank can regulate the supply of funds and interest rates in the banking system, thereby affecting the borrowing costs and investment environment of the real economy. Chu Jie also pointed out that when implementing monetary policy, the central bank will comprehensively consider the global economic environment, price levels, asset bubbles and other factors to maintain the comprehensiveness and flexibility of the policy. He emphasized that the coordination of monetary policy and fiscal policy can achieve better macro-control effects. Zhang Wei listened with great interest. He had a deeper understanding of China's monetary policy and also expressed admiration for Chu Jie's outstanding achievements in the field of linguistics. They continued their walk and discussed other interesting topics.

67_3_2.content: Chu Jie and Zhang Wei occasionally walk together on weekends and exchange trivial matters in life. Chu Jie introduced the background and research results of this book to Zhang Wei in detail. He told Zhang Wei that this book was published in 1968 and is widely regarded as one of Barthes' masterpieces. 'The Cloisters of Naracona' mainly explores the communication nature of literature and the relationship between literature and other social and cultural fields. Through detailed analysis of literary works, Barthes tried to reveal the interactive relationship between authors and readers, as well as the meaning of works in specific social and cultural contexts. He also mentions important named entities such as Gideon Spenser and Flaubert, as well as Madame Bovary. Chu Jie told Zhang Wei that Bart focused on the examination of the author's personal experience, social background and creative motivations, and through these details, revealed the deep meaning and critical value of the work. In addition, 'The Cloisters of Narracón' also explores some important critical theories, such as Barthes's theoretical construction of the classification of narrator roles in novels and the relationship between characters, as well as criticism of the structure of modern novels. Chu Jie said that this book provides an in-depth discussion of literary criticism theory through the study of literary works. Through specific named entities, detailed analysis and theoretical construction, Barthes attempts to reveal the meaning and social background behind the work, as well as the interactive relationship between readers and the work. Chu Jie believes that this book provides useful inspiration for deepening our understanding of literary criticism. Zhang Wei was very interested in the information shared by Chu Jie. fengxiulan.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Fengxiulan**

Fengxiulan, affectionately known as Xiaolan, is a distinguished ecological designer based in China. At the age of 32, she has carved a niche in the field of ecological design through her innovative approach and dedication to sustainable development. With long hair and big bright eyes, she radiates a vibrant energy that matches her passion for the natural world.

An ardent lover of outdoor activities, Xiaolan finds joy in exploring nature, which fuels her creativity and deepens her understanding of ecological systems. Her enthusiasm for photography and plant research often complements her professional pursuits, allowing her to capture the essence of nature’s beauty and complexity.

Xiaolan’s educational background in Ecological Design has empowered her to make significant contributions to her field. She works at the Ecological Technology Company, where her ideas flourish and inspire others. Her commitment to innovation has been recognized through prestigious accolades, including the Ecological Design Award and the Innovation Technology Award.

Having published several influential papers, Xiaolan shares her knowledge with the world, advocating for sustainable practices. Her work is deeply influenced by her role model, Jennifer Caitlin, a pioneer in ecological design, whose legacy inspires Xiaolan’s quest for a harmonious balance between technology and nature.

She introduced in detail the practice of the Constituent Assembly using the Internet platform for information disclosure and online discussions, which allowed the Icelandic people to conveniently make suggestions and opinions on the content and draft of the constitution. Liu Ming was very interested in this case, and he also shared his research results on the political transformation case in Iceland. He mentioned that the Icelandic government successfully responded to the financial crisis and dissatisfaction by introducing new political practices and reforms, which provided lessons and inspiration for other countries. Feng Xiulan and Liu Ming exchanged views with each other during the discussion, and deeply discussed the significance of the case of Iceland's political transformation in improving the representativeness and inclusiveness of the political system. 68_6_2.content: On June 10, 2022, Feng Xiulan invited her neighbor Zhao Lei to visit the newly opened Xiangyan Restaurant. They live in the same apartment building, often attend community events together, and look out for each other. Zhao Lei is a person who loves food. He heard that the restaurant designed by Feng Xiulan was very unique, and he was full of expectations. When they entered the restaurant door, Zhao Lei was shocked by the huge crystal chandelier and luxurious lobby. There were pastries and desserts of various flavors on the marble counter in the lobby, and Zhao Lei couldn't help but stop and look at them. Then, they walked into the dining area along the spacious and bright corridor. Zhao Lei was surprised to find a huge world map hanging on the wall, showing the restaurant's culinary traditions and food cultures from all over the world. Feng Xiulan explained that this design was inspired by her research results in the field of ecological design. Upon entering the dining area, they discovered that the restaurant was designed with partitions to provide a private dining environment. Zhao Lei was attracted by one of the small private rooms called 'Natural Shade', which was decorated with simulated trees and green plants, giving people a feeling of being in nature. Feng Xiulan told Zhao Lei that the design was inspired by her love for plant research. Zhao Lei likes the atmosphere of this small private room very much. They continued to visit other areas, and Zhao Lei noticed that each table had a unique design and naming. In particular, there is a table called 'Celia', which uses luxurious linen tablecloths and silver tableware, giving it a noble and elegant feel. Feng Xiulan explained that the design of this table was inspired by her combination of ecology and technology. Zhao Lei greatly appreciated these design details and expressed his admiration for Feng Xiulan's smart and visionary leadership in the field of ecological design. Finally, they met a famous chef in the restaurant's kitchen, who was leading a team to prepare delicious dishes for customers. Feng Xiulan said that the chef is good at blending Eastern and Western cooking techniques, bringing unique and delicious dishes to Xiangyan Restaurant. Zhao Lei exclaimed, this is a restaurant that is not only beautifully designed but also has delicious dishes. They had a great time in the restaurant and enriched their knowledge of gastronomy and ecological design.
68_6_2.summary: Visit the newly opened Xiangyan Restaurant

68_7_0.content: Feng Xiulan and Li Ming are active members of the same community and have participated in community greening plans and environmental protection activities. Together they dug holes, cultivated soil, and watered the trees to ensure that each sapling received good growing conditions. They collaborate with each other in their work and exchange knowledge and experiences about plants. Feng Xiulan taught Li Ming how to plant saplings correctly and protect the environment in which the trees grow, while Li Ming shared some of his insights on plant care. After the event, Feng Xiulan and Li Ming admired the fruits of their labor together, watching the green saplings swaying in the breeze. They feel a deep sense of satisfaction and pride in knowing that their efforts contribute to environmental protection in their communities. This event not only strengthened the friendship between Feng Xiulan and Li Ming, but also inspired more community residents to participate in environmental protection. The cooperation and efforts of Feng Xiulan and Li Ming have created a better and more sustainable environment for the community.

Ye Hao.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Ye Hao**

Ye Hao, affectionately known as Xiaohao, is a dedicated occupational therapist hailing from China, currently aged 32. With short black hair and glasses, Ye Hao’s appearance reflects a professional who is deeply committed to his field. He is known for his expertise in occupational therapy, having achieved numerous accolades that underscore his contributions and dedication.

Ye Hao works at a prestigious medical institution, where his efforts have been recognized with the Occupational Therapist Annual Excellence Award, a testament to his outstanding work and dedication. His professional journey is inspired by a senior mentor whose remarkable contributions have left a lasting impact on the field of occupational therapy.

Education has been a cornerstone of Ye Hao’s career, with specialized training in occupational therapy serving as a foundation for his success. Beyond his professional life, Xiaohao has a passion for outdoor sports and reading, hobbies that bring balance and joy to his life. His active lifestyle is a reflection of the energetic and committed nature he brings to his work.

An Asian by ethnicity, Ye Hao embodies the spirit of innovation and compassion, consistently striving to make a difference in the lives of those he serves. Through his work and achievements, Ye Hao has established himself as a respected figure in the field.

69_0_0.content: Ye Hao and his wife Ye Xiu have a long-term marriage, supporting and taking care of each other. This day is Ye Xiu's birthday, and Ye Hao carefully planned a surprise. He got up early, prepared Ye Xiu's favorite breakfast, and placed a bouquet of carefully selected flowers on the dining table. Ye Hao contacted Ye Xiu's working hours in advance. He rushed to Ye Xiu's medical institution on time and gave her a beautiful birthday gift. The gift is a new book in the field of occupational therapy that Ye Xiu has been looking forward to. This book is considered a classic in the field and Ye Xiu likes it very much. When Ye Xiu accepted the gift, she was moved to tears and expressed her gratitude to Ye Hao for his care and thought. In the evening, Ye Hao made a reservation at a special restaurant 'Lishui Tower', which is a high-end Chinese restaurant with a strong Asian flavor. They tasted exquisite Chinese dishes and enjoyed a delicious dinner. After the meal, Ye Hao also arranged a special surprise event for Ye Xiu. He took Ye Xiu to a famous concert hall to enjoy a classical music concert. Ye Xiu is a music lover. She was moved by the beautiful music at the concert and spent an unforgettable birthday night with Ye Hao. This birthday surprise made Ye Xiu feel Ye Hao's deep love and care for her, and also made their family relationship more stable and happy.

Ye Xiu worked closely with Ye Hao during the design process to discuss and determine the overall style and design concept of the store. Together, they chose pure white and gold as the main colors to highlight the sense of fashion and luxury. Ye Xiu is responsible for selecting and matching display items, such as high heels and bags, to ensure they complement the style of the entire store. She also participated in the design of the fitting room and suggested the use of black metal grille partitions and mirror materials to increase privacy and space. Ye Xiu also carefully designed the rest area, choosing soft lighting and comfortable fabric sofas to provide customers with a comfortable and relaxing environment. Throughout the design process, Ye Xiu and Ye Hao supported and took care of each other, and they worked together to create an impressive fashion shopping experience for customers.

69_0_2.content: Ye Hao is deeply passionate about the study of cosmic background radiation, inspired by his role model in the scientific community. He regularly attended seminars and discussions on the topic, honing his knowledge and sharing ideas with experts in cosmology. Ye Xiu supported Ye Hao's scientific aspirations by managing family responsibilities, allowing Ye Hao to dedicate more time to his academic pursuits. Her encouragement gave Ye Hao the confidence to engage deeply with ongoing research in cosmic phenomena, helping him connect with researchers in the field and contribute to discussions about cosmic background radiation. Ye Hao's involvement in these intellectual communities strengthened his dedication to scientific research and furthered his career in occupational therapy, blending his love for science with his professional expertise.

69_1_0.content: Ye Hao and Li Ming have been friends for many years and often participate in outdoor activities together. This time they plan to go hiking in a natural park in a certain city on May 12, 2022. This park is located in a certain district of a city and has magnificent natural landscapes and diverse plants and animals. Ye Hao and Li Ming planned to meet somewhere at 8 a.m. and then take public transportation to the park. They were prepared with backpacks, hiking boots and outdoor gear for any situation they might encounter. Once they arrived at the park, they started exploring on foot. Along the way they enjoyed stunning mountain views, clear streams and beautiful wildflowers. They also observed some wild animals such as birds and squirrels. During lunch time, they found a suitable place for a picnic and enjoyed the food and the tranquility of nature. In the afternoon, they continued hiking and exploring more of the park. Before returning, they stopped at a viewing platform to admire the mountains and lakes in the distance. This outdoor activity brought Ye Hao and Li Ming closer together and allowed them to enjoy the beauty of nature and the joy of life.

The trip lasted five days and four nights and passed through magnificent mountains, lush forests and clear streams. Ye Hao and Li Ming fully felt the charm and power of nature. They carried their bags and walked on steep mountain roads, climbing and crossing various terrains. In the process, they inspire and help each other, and share each other's happiness and difficulties. Together they overcame difficulties and challenges such as long walks, difficult climbs and limited accommodation and food. At the end of each day's trip, they set up tents, cooked meals, and shared delicious food and laughter. During this trip, Ye Hao and Li Ming not only strengthened their friendship, but also broadened their horizons and gained awe and cherishment of nature. They encourage and support each other, making each other’s hikes more fulfilling and meaningful.

69_8_2.content: Wang Gang is one of the participants in Maria Jansen’s color and emotion research project. As an occupational therapist, Wang Gang is very interested in the fields of mental health and art psychology. After hearing about the research project, he signed up. During the research, Wang Gang first observed an oil painting 'Tranquility' with blue as the main tone. His heart rate stabilized and he felt a sense of calm and tranquility. Then, Wang Gang created freely based on the paintings he observed. He chose to use a blue color palette and used paint and brushes to express a sense of relaxation and calmness on the canvas. Finally, in the group discussion, Wang Gang shared his work and the meaning behind his creation. **Protagonist: Cheng Xiaohong**

Cheng Xiaohong, affectionately known as Xiaohong, is a distinguished government management expert from China, celebrated for her profound contributions to the field. At 35, Xiaohong holds a pivotal position as a government official, where her strategic acumen and dedication have propelled numerous initiatives, earning her a slew of prestigious awards. She proudly represents her Asian heritage and is renowned for her radiant smile and long black hair.

Xiaohong's journey in government management was shaped by her solid educational background, which laid the foundation for her successful career. Her innovative approach and leadership have not only driven significant improvements in governance but have also made her a respected figure among peers.

A lifelong learner, Xiaohong finds inspiration in the work of role models like Jack Ma, whose entrepreneurial spirit and vision resonate with her own ambitions. Outside her professional life, Xiaohong enjoys reading, traveling, and capturing moments through photography, pursuits that enrich her perspective and fuel her creativity.

Currently employed by government agencies, Xiaohong's work continues to influence policy and governance, reflecting her commitment to making a lasting impact in her field. Her story is one of dedication, vision, and excellence in government management.

He happened to see Cheng Xiaohong waiting for the bus at the bus stop, so he walked over and asked her for help. Cheng Xiaohong enthusiastically lent Chen Ming a QR code at the bus station so that he could scan the code to buy tickets. Chen Ming thanked Cheng Xiaohong gratefully and immediately used the QR code to purchase the ticket. He took the bus smoothly and arrived at his destination on time. This experience made Chen Ming deeply aware of the importance of helping neighbors, and he also appreciated Cheng Xiaohong's enthusiasm and friendliness even more.

70_7_0.content: Yang Li is also an avid shopper. She is as keen on participating in shopping festivals as Xiao Ming. At 8 o'clock in the morning, Yang Li also opened the e-commerce app on her mobile phone and discovered various shopping activities. She first participated in the rush sale event and successfully purchased a limited edition iPhone 13 Pro. This phone has always been her favorite. Then, Yang Li also participated in the special flash sale event and purchased a Huawei MateBook X Pro and a Sony camera, enjoying great discounts. At 10 a.m., she participated in the brand's limited-time discount event and chose an Armani suit and a pair of Gucci leather shoes. At 12 noon, Yang Li also participated in the takeout ordering lottery. She was lucky and won a 100 yuan shopping red envelope. At 3 o'clock in the afternoon, Yang Li found that her home appliances were a bit old and decided to take advantage of the shopping festival to buy new ones. She purchased a Midea washing machine, a Hisense refrigerator and a Sharp TV. When purchasing these home appliances, Yang Li also participated in the platform’s “Free Polaroid Shopping Vouchers” activity, and with good luck, she successfully obtained a 200 yuan shopping voucher. At 7 o'clock in the evening, Yang Li also participated in the group purchasing activity of the shopping festival. She and her friends purchased a large number of daily necessities. They obtained the group purchase price and received an additional 500 yuan group purchase red envelope. At 9 o'clock in the evening, Yang Li used the shopping red envelope she had won to buy several new clothes. During the brand's special sale, she bought a Versace dress and a pair of Prada high heels. Through the shopping festival activities, Yang Li also successfully saved a lot of money. After the shopping festival, she was very satisfied with the shopping experience and said she would continue to pay attention to similar shopping festivals to buy more affordable products for herself and her family.

Cheng Xiaohong and Yang Li worked together with shovels to cultivate the soil, provide nutrients for the newly planted saplings, and watered them together. They cooperate with each other in their work, participate actively, and have friendly exchanges with other community members. This volunteer work allowed Cheng Xiaohong to better understand the needs of the community and deeply appreciate the importance of community activities. Ran Lin.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Ran Lin**

Ran Lin, affectionately known as Kobayashi, is a distinguished physical chemist hailing from China. At 35 years old, he stands tall and thin, with short hair and glasses that give him a scholarly appearance. His dedication to the scientific realm is evident through his occupation as a scientist at the Academy of Sciences, where he delves deeply into the study of matter's properties.

Ran Lin's passion for physical chemistry stems from his educational background in the field, and his commitment to advancing scientific knowledge is showcased through his prolific publication record. His papers have contributed significantly to the understanding of physical chemistry, earning him the prestigious Excellent Research Award.

In his spare time, Kobayashi immerses himself in scientific literature, continuously seeking inspiration from the works of his role model, Marie Curie. Her groundbreaking contributions to science serve as a guiding light for Ran Lin's own endeavors.

With a background rooted in Asian culture, Ran Lin embodies a blend of intellectual pursuit and cultural heritage, driving him to push the boundaries of scientific exploration. His achievements and dedication have made him a respected figure in the scientific community, inspiring future generations of chemists.

In 2019, China and ASEAN signed the China-ASEAN Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (RCEP), the result of eight years of negotiations. This agreement is of great significance to the trade relations between China and ASEAN. According to the terms of the agreement, China will implement zero tariffs with ASEAN countries, creating good conditions for trade flows between the two parties. Especially for the apparel industry, the signing of this agreement will have an important impact. Some famous Chinese clothing brands, such as Li Ning, Heilan House, Xtep, etc., will have more opportunities to enter the ASEAN market. At the same time, ASEAN clothing brands imported from China will also enter the Chinese market at lower tariff rates. This will enhance the international competitiveness of the garment industries of the two countries and provide more opportunities and cooperation space for enterprises. As scientists in the field of physical chemistry, both Ran Lin and Li Ming are excited about the prospect of this cooperation. They have studied the contents of the RCEP agreement in depth and predict that it will bring more extensive trade cooperation and mutually beneficial and win-win opportunities between China and ASEAN.

71_7_1.content: On May 12, 2022, Ran Lin and his colleague Zhang Qiang decided to explore China's Danxia landform. As a biochemist, Zhang Qiang also has a strong interest in geographical landscapes. They chose to go to Danxia Mountain in Shaoguan City, Guangdong Province, which is one of the most famous representatives of Danxia landforms in China. Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang prepared the necessary equipment, including hiking shoes, backpacks and cameras, to record their adventure. They set out from the Scientific Research Institute, took trains and buses, and finally arrived at their destination after several hours of journey. Upon arriving at Danxia Mountain, Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang were shocked by the magnificent scenery in front of them. They first visited the main attractions of Danxia Mountain, including Wangxian Rock, Feilong Cave and Four Eyes Well. Ran Lin was very interested in the historical background and geological features of these scenic spots, while Zhang Qiang focused on observing the surrounding vegetation and animals. They found that the landform of Danxia Mountain is indeed very unique, with red rock towers and cliffs forming a spectacular landscape. Ran Lin analyzed the composition and formation process of the rock, and shared some knowledge about geology and chemistry with Zhang Qiang. While exploring the Danxia landform, Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang also encountered some rare animals and plants. They were thrilled to discover an orangutan and an Asian elephant. Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang immediately took out their cameras and recorded this rare scene. In addition, they discovered some rare plants, including a variety of trees, flowers, and ferns. The entire expedition lasted for one day, and Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang returned to the resort in Danxia Mountain. Together they reviewed the gains and feelings of the expedition and exchanged their observations and findings with each other. Both Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang have gained a deeper understanding of the Danxia landform and plan to use these observations for scientific research. They decided to co-write a scientific research paper on Danxia landform to present their research results after returning to the Academy of Sciences. Through this joint adventure, Ran Lin and Zhang Qiang not only deepened their cooperative relationship, but also enriched their respective scientific knowledge. Zeng Jianhua.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Zeng Jianhua**

Zeng Jianhua, affectionately known as Xiaohua, is a 35-year-old agricultural economist from China. With a medium build, black hair, and glasses, he is a distinguished figure in the field of agricultural economics. Xiaohua holds an educational background in agricultural economics and currently serves as a leading expert at a prestigious agricultural research institute. His passion for growing crops and studying agricultural markets has driven him to publish numerous research papers, contributing significantly to the understanding of global agricultural dynamics.

As an expert in agricultural economics, Zeng Jianhua has earned the Outstanding Contribution Award in Agricultural Economics, highlighting his impactful work and dedication to advancing the field. His research often draws inspiration from Li Dazhi, a renowned agricultural economist, whom he regards as a role model. Through his innovative approaches and thorough analysis, Xiaohua has become an influential voice in the agricultural community, advocating for sustainable practices and market efficiency.

With a commitment to improving agricultural practices and enhancing food security, Zeng Jianhua continues to make strides in his career. He aims to bridge the gap between theory and practical application, ensuring that agricultural economics plays a pivotal role in shaping a sustainable future.

Deng Xiuying.profile_description:
Deng Xiuying

Deng Xiuying, affectionately known as Xiaoying, is a dedicated agricultural educator from China, who, at the age of 30, has already made significant contributions to the field of agricultural education. With her comprehensive background in agricultural education, Xiaoying is committed to enhancing the agricultural practices and knowledge of rural communities across China.

Her passion for agriculture was ignited during her studies, where she immersed herself in understanding sustainable farming techniques and modern agricultural methods. This education has empowered her to become a beacon of knowledge and support for many aspiring farmers and agricultural students.

Xiaoying's approach to education is not only about imparting knowledge but also about inspiring the younger generation to appreciate and innovate in the field of agriculture. Her engaging teaching methods and ability to connect with her students make her a beloved figure in her community.

Despite not holding any formal titles or awards yet, her contributions to agricultural education have not gone unnoticed. She remains a humble yet influential figure, driven by the desire to see China’s agricultural sector thrive through education and innovation. Her ultimate goal is to cultivate a future where agriculture is both a respected and progressive field, guided by informed and passionate individuals.

73_0_0.content: As an agricultural educator, Deng Xiuying collaborated with Wang Xiaohua, her sister, on an educational initiative to teach sustainable farming practices in rural communities. They organized workshops and training sessions for local farmers to promote eco-friendly techniques such as crop rotation, organic fertilizers, and water conservation. Deng Xiuying brought her expertise in agricultural education, while Wang Xiaohua provided organizational support. The project aimed to increase crop yields and improve the livelihoods of rural families while preserving the environment. Together, they successfully engaged the community and helped implement sustainable farming practices, contributing to the local economy and environment.

Together, they coordinated with local government bodies to implement environmental projects aimed at improving rural agricultural efficiency. Although Xiaohua was not a project manager, she played a crucial role in facilitating communication between the farmers and government agencies. Deng Xiuying's expertise in agriculture greatly enhanced the project's credibility and success, as she led workshops and training sessions that provided valuable insights to the community. Their combined efforts led to a significant improvement in sustainable farming practices in the region.

Li Ming is a student who loves mathematics and has a strong interest in Lorentz attractors. Deng Xiuying was his childhood sweetheart. Because of their common interests and excellent mathematical talent, they often discussed mathematical problems together. They spent a lot of time reading relevant literature, learning numerical simulation methods, and using numerical simulation methods such as Euler's method and Runge-Kutta method to draw the trajectory of the Lorentz attractor in three-dimensional space. By observing and analyzing the morphology and behavior of the Lorentz attractor, they gained a deep understanding of the non-periodic, chaotic and sensitively dependent properties of the Lorentz system. They also changed the parameters of the Lorentz equation, explored the changing rules of the attractor shape, and further studied the stability of the dynamic system. Through this research, Deng Xiuying and Li Ming not only enhanced their friendship with each other, but also deepened their understanding of mathematical dynamical systems and contributed to the development of chaos theory.
73_1_0.Theme: Research on dynamical systems in the field of mathematics

Shi Jie.profile_description:
**Profile: Shi Jie (Xiaojie)**

Shi Jie, affectionately known as Xiaojie, is a 28-year-old electrical engineer from China. Sporting short hair and glasses, Shi Jie is a dedicated professional who combines technical expertise with a passion for innovation. Employed at a renowned electrical engineering company, his work is characterized by precision and creativity, leading to numerous accolades in both domestic and international design competitions.

Shi Jie's journey into the world of electrical engineering was profoundly influenced by his father, whose legacy inspires him daily to strive for excellence. With a solid educational foundation in electrical engineering, Shi Jie has successfully transformed his academic knowledge into practical solutions that address complex engineering challenges.

Outside of work, Shi Jie is an avid reader, continuously expanding his knowledge across various subjects. His love for programming fuels his innovative projects, while traveling offers him fresh perspectives and inspiration. Shi Jie's commitment to lifelong learning and improvement is evident in his personal and professional life, where he remains at the forefront of technological advancements. Shi Jie's blend of expertise, inspiration, and curiosity positions him as a respected figure in the engineering community, continually pushing boundaries and seeking new horizons.

74_1_0.content: Shi Jie and his long-time friend Zhang Ming attended the Candy World series candy launch conference held by XX Candy Factory. The venue is located in a luxury hotel in the beautiful city of XX. Candy factory executives personally introduced the features and flavors of the newly launched Candy World series of candies. Zhang Ming and Shi Jie tried various flavors of candies, including Symphony Forest, Volcanic Eruption, and Angel Kiss. They were deeply attracted by the rich taste and exquisite appearance of the candies, and praised the Candy World series of candies. Shi Jie was also given a taster of the Candy World series of candies at the press conference, which made him look forward to tasting more candies with more flavors.
74_1_0.summary: Participate in the Candy World Series Candy Conference

74_1_1.content: Shi Jie and Zhang Ming have been friends for many years and have experienced many things together. In 2015, Zhang Ming celebrated his birthday, and Shi Jie decided to plan an unforgettable birthday party for him. They rented a private room in a restaurant and invited Zhang Ming's relatives and friends to celebrate together. Shi Jie contacted Zhang Ming's family and friends in advance and secretly arranged a series of surprise activities. On the day of the party, Shi Jie arrived at the restaurant early and prepared a special birthday cake and carefully selected gifts. When Zhang Ming arrived, he was warmly welcomed by Shi Jie and other friends. At the party, everyone shared delicious food, chatted and laughed, and sent blessings and gifts to Zhang Ming. Shijie also prepared a video looking back on their years of friendship, including photos and memories of them traveling, programming and reading together. The whole party was full of laughter and warm atmosphere. Zhang Ming was very moved. He said this was the most unforgettable birthday in his life. The friendship between Shi Jie and Zhang Ming became deeper because of this birthday party. They supported and encouraged each other and became indispensable in each other's lives.

74_2_0.content: Shi Jie and his girlfriend Wang Li are both interested in information theory in the field of mathematics. They often read relevant papers and books together to discuss the theoretical basis of information transmission and compression. On a sunny weekend afternoon, Shi Jie and Wang Li decided to go to the library together to borrow some classic works on information theory. They are keen to understand the key concepts of information entropy, source coding and channel coding proposed by Claude Shannon. In the library, Shi Jie and Wang Li read Shannon's classic works together and shared their understandings and ideas with each other. They discuss the importance of information entropy in quantifying information uncertainty, and the application of source coding and channel coding in data transmission and processing. Shi Jie also introduced specific coding methods such as Huffman coding and Hamming code to Wang Li, as well as their role in information compression and error correction. After spending a pleasant time in the library, Shi Jie and Wang Li decided to apply what they had learned to practical problems. They jointly developed a small experiment to use Huffman coding to encode and decode a piece of text information, verifying the effectiveness of the encoding method. Through this joint study and practice, Shi Jie and Wang Li not only deepened their understanding of information theory, but also enhanced their feelings for each other.

74_2_1.content: Shi Jie and his girlfriend Wang Li decided to travel to Germany together. One of the important itineraries was a visit to the German Bundestag. They took a group photo in front of the Reichstag in Berlin and left wonderful memories. Before entering the Capitol, they went through strict security checks, presented valid identification and received visit passes. Upon entering the hall, they were attracted by the spectacular architecture and unique decoration. They visited the parliament hall and listened to a detailed explanation of the German parliamentary system. The commentator introduced the process of parliamentary elections, the role of parliamentarians and the internal operating mechanism of parliament. Shi Jie and Wang Li were very curious about Germany's parliamentary system. They actively participated in discussions with other tourists and asked some questions to the tour guide. After the visit, they also purchased some souvenirs about the German Parliament as a souvenir of this unforgettable trip.

74_4_0.content: In a well-known electrical engineering company, Shi Jie and Liu Tao are working partners. They are responsible for developing new optical devices in the same project team. One day, Shi Jie and Liu Tao were discussing the challenges of optical device design. Liu Tao mentioned to Shi Jie the recent research results on the optical microstructure of shark skin that he had seen in the media. He told Shi Jie that this study found that the shark fin skin texture on the shark's skin has the effect of multiple reflections and scattering of light, thereby improving the shark's stealth performance. Shi Jie was very excited when he heard about this interesting discovery and immediately launched in-depth research. Shi Jie and Liu Tao read relevant scientific papers together and discussed how to apply this discovery to the optical devices they are developing. They decided to use the optical microstructure of shark skin as inspiration to try to design a new optical material with similar properties. In the next few months, Shi Jie and Liu Tao worked together to continuously optimize the design plan and conduct experimental verification. Ultimately, they successfully developed an efficient antibacterial optical material and successfully applied it to fields such as medical devices and food packaging. The success of this project was due to the close collaboration and innovative thinking of Shi Jie and Liu Tao, who together overcame technical challenges and achieved impressive results.

74_4_1.content: During a lunch break, Shi Jie and his work partner Liu Tao talked about film and television character modeling in the field of television and film. They mentioned the styling in 'Blackjack.' Shi Jie details the special mask and coat design of protagonist Rorschach, as well as the retro-style costume of Silk Specter, the only female superhero in the film. Liu Tao also expressed interest in these looks, adding that they present a superhero world full of personality and style to the audience through details such as clothing, makeup and hairstyle. The two enjoyed this interesting discussion while enjoying their lunch. They all marveled at the unique design of the characters in the movie and believed that this carefully crafted look added a unique visual charm to the film.

74_4_2.content: Shi Jie and Liu Tao were chatting together during lunch time at the company, and they happened to talk about philosophy and ethics. Liu Tao is very interested in the perspectives of individualism and collectivism and wants to know more about them. Shi Jie was keen on reading and had some understanding of the field of philosophy, so he shared with Liu Tao Al Gore's 'Social Contract', a typical individualistic case. He told Liu Tao that this work was published by French philosopher Jean-Jacques Rousseau in 1762 and put forward a series of views on society, politics and morality. Shi Jie introduced in detail that the 'Social Contract Theory' advocates that individuals have important autonomy in participating in the establishment and exercise of power by the government, and emphasizes the protection of individual rights and that the government should obey the will of the people. He also mentioned that this work had a profound impact on the French Revolution and the American Independence Movement, as well as providing important thinking on modern political philosophy and ethics. Shi Jie also joined Liu Tao to discuss concepts such as personal freedom, human rights, equality and social justice, citing the views of Rousseau and other famous philosophers and thinkers. They conducted an in-depth discussion on the conflict between individualism and collectivism and shared their respective insights and perspectives. This discussion gave Liu Tao a deeper understanding of individualism and stimulated his interest in philosophy and ethics.
74_4_2.summary: Discuss the perspectives of individualism and collectivism

In his cooperation with Yang Fan, Xiaojie developed a strong interest in the research of battery materials. Yang Fan helped Xiaojie understand the basic principles and structures of battery materials and introduced some of the latest research progress. Together they discussed lithium-ion batteries and their applications in renewable energy and electric vehicles. Yang Fan also provided Xiaojie with the opportunity to participate in a research project on lithium-ion battery materials, which gave Xiaojie the opportunity to personally participate in the design and preparation of lithium-ion batteries. Under the guidance of Yang Fan, Xiaojie successfully improved the performance of lithium-ion batteries through experiments and theoretical simulations, and published relevant papers. These research results have laid a solid foundation for Xiaojie's career development in the field of electrical engineering, enabling him to win a number of awards in domestic and foreign electrical engineering design competitions. Xiaojie has always regarded Yang Fan as his role model. He knows that his achievements in academic and career paths are inseparable from Yang Fan's careful guidance and support.

Lei Xia.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Lei Xia**

Lei Xia, affectionately known as Xiaoxia, is a dynamic environmental health expert hailing from China. At the age of 30, she has already established herself as a prominent figure in the field of environmental health, leveraging her expertise and passion to drive meaningful change. With a healthy complexion framed by black hair and dark eyes, Lei embodies the vitality of someone deeply committed to the well-being of our planet.

Her professional journey is marked by rich experience and significant contributions to numerous environmental protection projects, reflecting her dedication to sustainability and the health of communities. Lei’s educational background in environmental health has provided her with a strong foundation to tackle complex challenges and innovate solutions for pressing environmental issues.

She currently collaborates with leading environmental organizations, where her insights and strategies have earned her the prestigious Environmental Pioneer Award. Drawing inspiration from her role model, Jayne Gooden, Lei Xia continually seeks to expand her impact and influence.

Outside of her professional pursuits, Lei enjoys outdoor sports, reading, and engaging in various environmental activities. Her ethnic roots in Asia serve as a guiding force in her commitment to preserving natural ecosystems and promoting global environmental health.
