112_0_0.content: Deng Jun is Deng Ming's family member and is full of support and encouragement for his concert performances. Deng Ming is a young musician who is good at playing classical music. He recently attended a concert playing Beethoven's Symphony of Destiny. Deng Jun not only actively bought tickets to watch, but also expressed his heartfelt congratulations to Deng Ming after the concert. He deeply admired Deng Ming's playing skills and musical expression and expressed to him that he was very proud. Deng Jun learned that 'Symphony of Destiny', as a classic work with world influence, has profound emotional connotation and rich musical language. He shared with Deng Ming the background in which Beethoven composed this work and the emotional themes conveyed in different parts of the movement. Deng Jun hopes that Deng Ming can continue to study hard, continuously improve his musical talent, and bring more wonderful music experiences to people.
112_0_0.Theme: The family relationship between Deng Jun and Deng Ming

112_0_1.content: Deng Jun and Deng Ming are close brothers who often support and help each other. They grew up together and share similar values and interests. Deng Jun has accumulated rich experience in the field of social work, and Deng Ming also has a strong interest in social issues and public welfare undertakings. Whenever Deng Jun participates in volunteer work or social justice activities, Deng Ming always actively participates and provides support. They often participate in community events together and work together to promote social justice and human rights. Deng Ming was also Deng Jun's closest friend and confidant, establishing a deep emotional bond between them. Whether it was difficulties at work or challenges in personal life, Deng Jun and Deng Ming always talked and gave each other advice. Their mutual support and help is the most important feature of their relationship and one of the important factors in their growth and success.
112_0_1.Theme: The relationship between Deng Jun and Deng Ming

112_0_2.content: In 2008, when the subprime mortgage crisis broke out in the United States, Deng Jun's brother Deng Ming provided valuable support and help to Deng Jun. As an experienced social worker, Deng Jun saw many families facing difficulties due to financial difficulties during the crisis. He decided to take active action to help those affected by the subprime mortgage crisis. Deng Ming learned of Deng Jun's efforts and immediately contacted him to express his support and encouragement for his work. Deng Ming not only supported Deng Jun financially, but also helped Deng Jun expand the influence of social work and provided him with valuable advice and resources. The close relationship between Deng Ming and Deng Jun allowed them to rely on and support each other, which greatly promoted Deng Jun's work in the field of social work. Through cooperation and mutual support with Deng Ming, Deng Jun provided help and support to many people affected by the subprime mortgage crisis, helping them tide over difficult times.

112_1_0.content: Deng Jun and Zhang Na participated in a wonderful Tai Chi performance during the 2010 Spring Festival. The performance was held at a Spring Festival party held by their university. That night, the venue was decorated with colorful decorations and lights flashed. Deng Jun and Zhang Na were sitting in the audience, eagerly waiting for the Tai Chi performance to begin. Tai Chi performers wear traditional Tai Chi suits and demonstrate the gentleness and power of Tai Chi step by step. The performers' movements are soothing and powerful, full of beauty and rhythm. Deng Jun and Zhang Na were impressed by the performers' superb skills. Their eyes were focused and they watched with concentration. After the performance, Deng Jun and Zhang Na were full of praise for the performers' skills and exchanged their understanding and insights of Tai Chi with each other. They were all deeply attracted by Tai Chi and decided to learn Tai Chi together in the following days and experience the charm and benefits of Tai Chi together.

112_1_1.content: Deng Jun and Zhang Na were good friends in college and spent a lot of happy time together. Recently, they went to the cinema to watch the much-anticipated domestic movie 'The Eight Hundred'. Deng Jun was interested in the theme and plot of the movie because, as a social worker, he is well aware of the impact of war on society and individuals. Zhang Na is also very interested in this movie. She likes movies with historical themes and is full of respect for stories from the war period. While watching the movie, they were attracted by the real historical plot and wonderful actors' performances in the movie. Together, they felt the tragic atmosphere of war and the kindness and perseverance of human nature conveyed in the movie. After watching the movie, they sat down in a cafe near the cinema and discussed the plot and characters in the movie. They communicated in depth, shared each other's feelings and opinions, and further deepened their friendship.
112_1_1.Theme: The friendship between Deng Jun and Zhang Na

112_2_0.content: Deng Jun’s girlfriend Li Lu is a history buff and is very interested in the great plague in Europe in the 14th century. She is keen on studying this specific case and often shares relevant historical knowledge with Deng Jun. During a romantic date, Li Lu told Deng Jun about the outbreak of the Great Plague in Europe and its impact on society at that time. She describes in detail the plague that arrived in the Italian port of Siena from Moldova in 1347 and then spread rapidly throughout Europe. She mentioned that the rapid spread of the virus has led to massive deaths. The population of many cities has plummeted, and there is nowhere to put the bodies. Li Lu particularly emphasized the severe damage suffered by London during the Great Plague. About half of the population died from the plague, and the city fell into panic and chaos. She told Deng Jun that at the peak of the epidemic, hospitals and officials in London were unable to effectively handle so many patients, resulting in infected people being ignored and rejected. In order to survive, many infected people have to deal with the disease on their own. Li Lu also mentioned that the British writer Chaucer was a famous survivor of the Black Death. His work 'The Canterbury Tales' recorded the scene of the plague at that time. One of his friends carried the virus when he fled London, triggering a crisis. Series of stories. Deng Jun was deeply interested in Li Lu's knowledge and description. During the exchange, they discussed the profound impact of the plague on the society at that time, as well as people's bravery and tenacity in the face of difficulties. This topic brings them closer, deepening their understanding and support in the pursuit of happiness together.

112_2_1.content: In 2015, Deng Jun and his girlfriend Li Lu visited the Shenzhen Longgang Pingdi Environmental Protection Comprehensive Utilization Project. As an environmental protection worker, Deng Jun was very interested in this project and took Li Lu to the project site. During the visit, they had an in-depth understanding of the background and construction of the project. Deng Jun introduced the importance of this project to Li Lu and its role in solving the waste disposal problem in Shenzhen. They visited functional areas such as waste transfer stations, domestic waste incineration power plants, waste treatment centers and food waste treatment centers, and learned in detail about the processes and equipment in each area. Deng Jun and Li Lu were shocked by the advanced environmental protection technologies used in the project, especially the thermal energy conversion in the domestic waste incineration power plant and the classification processing technology in the waste treatment center. They believe this project is of great significance in protecting the environment and achieving sustainable development. After the visit, Deng Jun and Li Lu had an in-depth exchange of ideas and discussed how to contribute to environmental protection in their work and life. They decided to work together to take more actions to support and participate in environmental protection work. This visit also played a positive role in promoting their relationship, deepened their mutual understanding and trust, and strengthened their determination to pursue happiness together.
112_2_1.summary: Deng Jun and Li Lu jointly visited Shenzhen Longgang Pingdi Environmental Protection Comprehensive Utilization Project

112_2_2.content: Deng Jun and Li Lu planned to spend a romantic day over the weekend. They decided to go for a walk and picnic in the city park and enjoy the beauty of nature. Deng Jun made full preparations in advance, bringing a homemade lunch and Li Lu’s favorite fruits. They laid out a blanket on the park lawn and placed some flowers and candles to add a romantic atmosphere to the date. They chatted while tasting delicious food, sharing each other's preferences and dreams. In the sunny weather, they admired the blooming flowers in the park and enjoyed the warmth of the breeze. Li Lu was happy and touched by Deng Jun's careful and romantic actions, while Deng Jun felt happy and satisfied that he could spend this wonderful time with Li Lu. This romantic date made them more understanding and supportive of each other, deepening their relationship.
112_2_2.Theme: Deng Jun and Li Lu’s romantic date

112_3_0.content: As a social worker, Deng Jun often exchanges experiences and resources with Chen Yu. One day, Deng Jun met with Chen Yu, and they talked about film and television marketing in the field of television and movies. Deng Jun mentioned the marketing strategy of the movie 'The Jungle Book' and introduced in detail the innovative measures made by the film production company in terms of publicity, global premieres, cooperation with brands, mobile game promotion, and cooperation with TV stations and streaming media platforms. . After hearing this, Chen Yu agreed and added some other marketing strategies he learned about. They shared each other's views on marketing during the exchange and encouraged and inspired each other. This exchange allowed Deng Jun to better understand various methods and strategies of film marketing, and also provided some useful reference for his work in the field of social work.
112_3_0.summary: Shared the marketing strategy of the movie 'The Jungle Book'
112_3_0.Theme: Fantasy Forest Film and Television Marketing Case

112_3_1.content: Deng Jun and Chen Yu are acquaintances in the social work field and often exchange experiences and resources. During an exchange, Deng Jun learned that Chen Yu had a certain interest in the field of financial management and learned that Chen Yu hoped to obtain investment opportunities with stable growth and higher returns. Based on his rich experience in the field of social work, Deng Jun decided to recommend to Chen Yu a fund that has attracted much attention recently, called 'Abundant Growth'. He introduced to Chen Yu that the fund mainly invests in the field of technological innovation, especially the Internet, artificial intelligence and new energy industries. Deng Jun also mentioned that the fund manager of Fengsheng Growth Fund is Li Minghua, a well-known investment expert, who has rich industry experience and unique investment vision. The fund's investment strategy focuses on long-term investment and uses a combination of quantitative analysis and fundamental research. Deng Jun told Chen Yu that the fund pays more attention to the balanced distribution of sub-sectors in the allocation of investment portfolios, and currently holds the stocks of multiple Internet giants including Tencent, Alibaba, and Baidu, as well as Tesla and Ningde The stocks of leading companies such as Times. According to the latest fund announcement, the net value of Fengsheng Growth Fund has exceeded the average rate of similar funds for four consecutive quarters. Deng Jun also reminded Chen Yu that fund companies provide flexible subscription and redemption mechanisms so that investors can freely adjust their positions according to their own needs, and provide a professional financial advisory team to provide investors with comprehensive consultation and personalized investment advice. Chen Yu expressed his gratitude to Deng Jun for his recommendation and decided to learn more about the fund in order to make his own investment decisions.
112_3_1.summary: Deng Jun recommended to Chen Yu the recently launched fund called 'Funding Growth'
112_3_1.Theme: Fund cases in the financial management field

112_3_2.content: At the social gathering of Deng Jun and Chen Yu, they talked about the latest ATLAS detector experimental results. Chen Yu introduced to Deng Jun the recent important progress made by the ATLAS team in the field of Higgs boson and dark matter research. Chen Yu described in detail that the ATLAS team observed new particle pairs produced by the decay of Higgs boson particles through the LHC experiment, and verified through precise data analysis that these new particles are evidence of the existence of Higgs bosons. He also mentioned the achievements of the ATLAS team in dark matter research. Through the analysis of particle trajectories and decay processes produced by high-energy collisions, they continue to push the frontier of dark matter research. Deng Jun expressed his admiration for the work of the ATLAS team introduced by Chen Yu, and said that their research results have played an important role in promoting human understanding of the physics of the universe and the properties of elementary particles. During the exchange, they shared each other's enthusiasm and interest in high-energy physics research, and encouraged and supported each other's work.
112_3_2.summary: New experimental results from the ATLAS detector

112_4_0.content: As colleagues in the social work field, Deng Jun and Liu Ting launched a community education activity together. This event aims to provide educational support and resources to disadvantaged groups in the community, especially those who do not have adequate access to educational opportunities. Activities include setting up free study classes, providing course tutoring and learning resources to help community residents improve their skills and knowledge. Deng Jun and Liu Ting jointly planned the course content and arranged for professional teachers and volunteers to participate in the teaching work. They also contacted local schools and libraries to secure donations of some teaching materials and learning resources to ensure that every participant could obtain necessary learning materials. During the event, Deng Jun and Liu Ting were responsible for organizing and coordinating various tasks to ensure the smooth progress of the event. They also actively promoted the event and attracted the participation and support of many community residents. Through this community education activity, Deng Jun and Liu Ting helped many community residents obtain educational resources, improving their quality of life and opportunities for future development. Their collaboration and efforts have made a positive impact on the community and set an example for social workers.

112_4_1.content: Deng Jun and Liu Ting are colleagues in a social work project who work together to provide support to vulnerable groups. In a recent project, they worked to help homeless people reintegrate into society. Liu Ting played an important role in this project, establishing a close and trusting relationship with the homeless and providing necessary assistance and support. Liu Ting often has face-to-face conversations with homeless people, listening to their stories and plights, helping them build self-confidence, find employment opportunities, and provide psychological counseling. She also assists homeless individuals in finding shelter and works with community resources to provide necessary shelter and basic supplies. Deng Jun and Liu Ting worked closely on the project, sharing each other's experience and resources to ensure that their services could help those in need to the greatest extent possible. They work together to promote social justice and human rights through active participation in social justice activities. Their cooperative relationship is close and harmonious, supporting and encouraging each other, bringing hope and change to disadvantaged groups.
112_4_1.summary: Liu Ting’s contribution to social work projects

112_4_2.content: Deng Jun is a social worker and is a colleague of Liu Ting. One day, when Deng Jun was chatting with Liu Ting during a break at work, Liu Ting mentioned the skin problems she had recently encountered. She told Deng Jun that her skin had recently experienced inflammatory reactions, redness, swelling and allergies, which troubled her. After Deng Jun heard this, he thought of the 'Qingrouji Benshu' anti-inflammatory beauty product he had learned about before. He introduced the features and efficacy of this product to Liu Ting in detail and recommended it to her. Deng Jun told Liu Ting that 'Qingrouji Benshu' uses precious plant ingredients from the ocean, which has good anti-inflammatory and soothing effects on the skin, and can quickly reduce sensitivity, redness and other problems. He also provided Liu Ting with usage methods and precautions, and suggested that she undergo an allergy test or seek professional advice before use. Liu Ting expressed her gratitude to Deng Jun for his suggestion and decided to try this product to improve her skin problems. Deng Jun and Liu Ting work together in social work projects that provide support to disadvantaged groups, not only caring about their work, but also caring about each other's lives and health.

112_5_0.content: During a career development discussion, Deng Jun’s mentor Yang Fan mentioned to him the success of the Chinese film “The Wandering Earth.” Yang Fan explained the film's great success in terms of box office and word-of-mouth, and emphasized the rapid development of China's cultural industry and the increase in international influence reflected in it. He pointed out that 'The Wandering Earth' is not only a commercial film, but also a cultural work that combines the essence of Chinese technology and art, representing the rise of China's cultural industry. Deng Jun deeply agreed with this and asked Yang Fan about the reasons behind the rapid development of China's film industry. Yang Fan explained that the rapid development of China's film industry is due to the government's support and encouragement, as well as the emergence of more and more outstanding film talents. He also mentioned that the active participation of Chinese technology companies and institutions in film production also played a key role in the film's success. Yang Fan encouraged Deng Jun to learn from the successful experience of the Chinese film industry in his social work, and to promote the progress of social justice and human rights by cooperating with people in different fields and enhance his professional influence. Deng Jun expressed his gratitude to Yang Fan for his guidance and support, and decided to have a deeper understanding of the development of China's cultural industry and its integration with social work.
112_5_0.summary: Deng Jun and Yang Fan discuss the success of 'The Wandering Earth' and the development of China's cultural industry

112_5_1.content: In the early stages of Deng Jun's career development, his mentor Yang Fan gave him important guidance and support. Yang Fan is an experienced social worker who has made outstanding achievements in the field of social work. As Deng Jun's mentor, he understands Deng Jun's professional abilities and potential and is committed to helping him grow. He and Deng Jun worked out a career development plan together, helping Deng Jun determine his career goals and direction. Yang Fan provided Deng Jun with rich social work experience sharing, taught him professional knowledge and skills, and guided him to deal with various social work challenges. At work, Yang Fan often cooperates with Deng Jun and personally guides him in community investigations, case management, and resource integration. He provides regular career guidance and evaluation to Deng Jun to help him continuously improve his abilities and professional standards. Yang Fan also provided many opportunities for Deng Jun to participate in important social work projects, giving him the opportunity to accumulate practical experience and demonstrate his abilities. Through Yang Fan's guidance and support, Deng Jun gradually grew into an excellent social worker. His work performance was highly recognized, and he gradually won the Outstanding Social Worker Award from the Social Work Association. Yang Fan's guidance not only played a key role in Deng Jun's career development, but also established a deep mentor-disciple relationship between them. They respected and trusted each other and became good partners.

112_5_2.content: As a social worker student, Deng Jun received the guidance and support of his mentor Yang Fan and made a breakthrough in his career development. Yang Fan is a senior social worker with rich experience and knowledge. He established a mentor-apprentice relationship with Deng Jun and provided Deng Jun with advice on personal career planning. Yang Fan often communicates with Deng Jun to share his thoughts and experiences in the field of social work. He helped Deng Jun set career development goals and guided him on how to improve his professional skills and knowledge. Under the guidance of Yang Fan, Deng Jun participated in some social work training and academic seminars to continuously learn and improve his abilities. Yang Fan also helped Deng Jun establish extensive social work contacts and introduced him to some experts and important figures in the industry. Through cooperation and guidance with Yang Fan, Deng Jun gradually emerged in the field of social work and gained more opportunities and challenges. His career breakthrough was recognized with the Outstanding Social Worker Award from the Association of Social Work. Deng Jun expressed his gratitude to Yang Fan for his guidance and support. He will continue to work hard to learn and grow and provide more help and support to disadvantaged groups.
112_5_2.summary: Deng Jun made a breakthrough in his career development
112_5_2.Theme: Social work mentors provide guidance and support

112_6_0.content: Deng Jun and Zhang Yong are neighbors who live in the same community, and they have a very friendly relationship. They often meet in the community, greet each other, and often communicate with each other about their lives. Both Deng Jun and Zhang Yong are very concerned about the development of the community and the welfare of residents, and often participate in community activities and volunteer work together. They have participated in community environmental protection activities together, provided assistance to the elderly in the community, and participated in charity sales organized by the community. Whether it is daily trivial matters or important community affairs, Deng Jun and Zhang Yong always look after and help each other. They established a deep relationship of friendship and trust and became an important support in each other's lives.
112_6_0.Theme: Deng Jun and Zhang Yong’s neighbor relationship

112_6_1.content: Recently, Zhang Yong has become very interested in Deng Jun's work, especially the intelligent rehabilitation assistant project. After he heard that Deng Jun's organization had successfully completed this innovative project, he decided to visit the office in person. He got the opportunity to visit through an appointment. Deng Jun warmly received Zhang Yong and introduced to him in detail the applications and advantages of the intelligent rehabilitation assistant project. Zhang Yong expressed high appreciation for the technology and services of the project, and expressed his respect for Deng Jun and his team. Zhang Yan.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Zhang Yan**

Zhang Yan, affectionately known as Xiaoyan, is a distinguished cultural management expert based in China. At 30 years old, Xiaoyan has already carved out a prominent space for herself in the realm of cultural management. As a cultural manager for a leading cultural institution, she boasts a wealth of experience and has been instrumental in planning numerous cultural activities that have garnered significant attention and accolades.

With her long black hair and slim figure, Xiaoyan embodies grace and poise, qualities she brings into her professional endeavors. Her passion for reading, traveling, and art appreciation fuels her creative spirit and informs her innovative approach to cultural management. Her ethnic background as Asian provides her with a unique perspective, enriching the cultural projects she undertakes.

An alumna with a major in Cultural Management, Xiaoyan has received the prestigious XXX Cultural Management Award, underscoring her excellence and dedication to the field. Her career is inspired by Li Ming, a renowned cultural management expert in China, whose influence is evident in her commitment to elevating cultural appreciation and awareness.

Zhang Yan's journey is marked by her significant achievements and her unwavering commitment to fostering cultural growth and engagement within her community.

She was moved by the complex and touching love story between Adele and Emma. Li Min, on the other hand, gently encouraged and shared his feelings about watching movies from time to time, and savored the details and artistic conception of the movie with Zhang Yan. After watching the movie, Zhang Yan expressed her love and gratitude for the movie to Li Min, and believed that this movie-watching experience had great inspiration and influence on her artistic creation and cultural management work. Li Min encouraged Zhang Yan to continue pursuing her dreams, devote herself to cultural management work with enthusiasm and professionalism, and continuously improve her professional qualities. 113_0_2.content: In June 2019, Zhang Yan decided to use the Intelligent Composition System to improve her composition level. As Zhang Yan’s sister, Li Min has always supported and encouraged her learning and development. She heard that the Intelligent Composition System had a high reputation in the field of education and learning, so she recommended it to Zhang Yan. Li Min learned that the Intelligent Composition System is a personalized composition tutoring system based on artificial intelligence, which can provide personalized writing strategies and real-time learning guidance based on students' characteristics and needs. She believes that this system will be of great help in improving Zhang Yan’s composition level. Therefore, Li Min encouraged Zhang Yan to actively use the smart composition system and provided support and help, hoping that she could further improve her writing skills through this system.

113_1_0.content: Zhang Yan and Wang Xiao met to visit Serengeti National Park to explore its unique vegetation distribution. They plan to set off on June 16, 2022, to visit this famous African savanna area along the border between Kenya and Tanzania. They can't wait to see the vast grasslands and unique bush landscapes with their own eyes. Wang Xiao is particularly interested in this case because she has a strong interest in natural ecology and vegetation distribution. She has participated in cultural management training courses with Zhang Yan and has unique insights into the integration of culture and nature. Their trip plan is an excellent opportunity not only to enrich their knowledge, but also to appreciate the unique landscapes and animal communities in nature. They prepare detailed itineraries that include visits to specific locations in grasslands and bushland, as well as viewing wonderful natural attractions such as the wildebeest migration. Zhang Yan and Wang Xiao both brought cameras and notebooks, ready to record this unforgettable travel experience, and hope to show more people the beauty and uniqueness of Serengeti National Park in Africa by sharing their experiences.
113_1_0.summary: Plan a visit to Serengeti National Park together

113_1_1.content: On March 15, 2022, Zhang Yan and her friend Wang Xiao discussed important chapters in the Quran at a dinner party. In particular, they talked about the first chapter of the Quran, Al-Fatiha, which is a branch of Zhang Yan’s study of cultural management. Zhang Yan introduced in detail the meaning and uses of Al-Fatiha, including its importance in daily worship by Muslims and as a medium for believers to connect with God. She mentioned the divine terms and concepts used in Al-Fatiha such as Ar-Rahman (The Benefactor of All), Alhamdulillah (All Praise be to God), Malik (The Sovereign), and Siraat al-Mustaqeem (The Right Way). They also discussed Al-Fatiha's role as a social and moral guide and as an important part of wedding ceremonies and memorial ceremonies in some cultures. This discussion not only deepened Zhang Yan’s understanding of the Quran, but also gave Wang Xiao a deeper understanding of Muslim religious practices.
113_1_1.summary: Discuss important verses from the Quran

113_1_2.content: Wang Xiao, Zhang Yan's college roommate and one of her best friends, came to the city of Dunhuang to visit the Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes. As a cultural management expert, Zhang Yan is very concerned about the protection of Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes. She specially accompanied Wang Xiao there, hoping that through a personal visit, Wang Xiao can have a deep understanding of the importance of this world cultural heritage. They came to Dunhuang City, Gansu Province, where the Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes are located, and felt the unique charm of this ancient art treasure. Under the guidance of a tour guide, they first visited some of the restored murals and cultural relics in the Mogao Grottoes, and admired the exquisite Buddhist murals and sculptures. Zhang Yan introduced the historical and cultural background of Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes to Wang Xiao, letting her understand the preciousness of this heritage and the pressure to protect it. They also visited the scriptures and cultural relics preserved in the Mogao Grottoes, read the contents of ancient Buddhist scriptures, and felt the ancient wisdom and beliefs. Zhang Yan and Wang Xiao were deeply moved by the artistic charm and historical heritage of Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes. They decided to contribute to the protection of Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes by disseminating and promoting culture and art in their own fields.
113_1_2.Theme: Heritage protection in the humanities and social fields

Yang Qiang.profile_description:
**Yang Qiang: The Cultural Explorer**

Yang Qiang, affectionately nicknamed "Cockroach" for his resilience and adaptability, is a distinguished gentleman at the age of 30. He is a cultural researcher at a prominent research institution in China, where he delves into the intricate tapestry of cultural studies. His towering height and slightly muscular build stand as a testament to his active lifestyle and zest for exploration.

A native of China, Yang's Asian heritage forms a rich backdrop for his academic pursuits. He has made significant strides in the field of cultural research, publishing numerous academic papers that have garnered attention and respect from peers worldwide. His dedication to understanding and preserving cultural nuances has earned him the prestigious Outstanding Youth Award, solidifying his place as a rising star in his domain.

Yang's educational journey in culture research has equipped him with profound insights and a critical eye, deeply influenced by his role model, the esteemed cultural scholar Li Ming. His passion extends beyond academia; he is an avid reader and traveler, always seeking to broaden his horizons and experience diverse cultures firsthand. A connoisseur of coffee, Yang enjoys tasting exotic blends during his travels, adding to his rich tapestry of experiences.

Yang Qiang is not just a cultural researcher; he embodies the spirit of discovery and learning, making significant contributions to the understanding of cultural dynamics across the globe.

Lai Hao.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Lai Hao**

Lai Hao, known affectionately as Xiaohao, is a distinguished gentleman from China. At the age of 30, Lai Hao stands tall with short black hair and deep eyes that reflect his dedication to his craft. He works as an agricultural mechanization engineer at the Academy of Agricultural Sciences, where his passion for innovation in agricultural technology flourishes. 

Lai Hao specializes in advancing agricultural mechanization, holding numerous patented technologies that have significantly contributed to the field. His achievements have been recognized with prestigious provincial science and technology progress awards, a testament to his impact on modernizing agriculture in China.

With an educational background in Agricultural Mechanization, Lai Hao devotes his time to reading agriculture-related literature, staying abreast of the latest advancements, and exploring new methods to enhance crop yields. Inspired by his role model, Yuan Longping, a revered Chinese agricultural scientist, Lai Hao is committed to the promotion and advancement of agricultural science, with a focus on increasing productivity and sustainability.

Through his work, Lai Hao embodies the innovative spirit of his ethnic Han nationality, aiming to make lasting contributions to the future of agriculture, while remaining grounded in his cultural heritage and professional aspirations.

Bao Juan.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Bao Juan**

Bao Juan, affectionately known as Xiaojuan, is a distinguished international business expert at the age of 32. As a seasoned international business consultant for International Trade Co., Ltd, Bao Juan brings a wealth of experience and deep knowledge in her field, making her a valuable asset in the global business landscape. Her journey began in China, where she developed a strong foundation through her Bachelor's Degree in International Business, allowing her to navigate complex cross-border transactions with ease.

With black hair and brown eyes complementing her medium build, Bao Juan exudes confidence and poise, which are essential in her line of work. Her professional prowess is matched by her personal passions, as she dedicates her leisure time to traveling, reading, and embracing new cultures—activities that broaden her perspective and enhance her understanding of international markets.

Bao Juan's achievements have not gone unnoticed; she received the prestigious Outstanding Contribution Award from the International Business Association. Her career has been shaped and inspired by figures like Mr. Li, a renowned business leader, whose influence helped cultivate her strategic thinking and leadership skills. Bao Juan continues to drive success and innovation in international business with her dedication and expertise.

117_1_0.content: Bao Juan and Li Ming were good friends in college and still maintain close contact. The last time they met was at a party on May 12, 2022. At this gathering, they talked about the molar structure in the field of chemistry. One of the famous cases was the theory of the molar structure of benzene proposed by the German chemist Friedrich August Kekulé von Stradonitz. Bao Juan introduced the molecular structure of benzene and Kekulé's theory to Li Ming in detail. She explained that benzene is an organic compound composed of six carbon atoms and six hydrogen atoms, and Kekulé believes that the benzene molecule is composed of a cyclic carbon skeleton, in which carbon atoms are connected by single and double bonds. . This molar structure not only explains the molecular shape and chemical properties of benzene, but also provides chemists with ideas for exploring more cyclic organic compounds. Bao Juan and Li Ming exchanged their views and understandings with each other during the discussion, and gained a deeper understanding of the molar structure of benzene. This discussion gave them a more comprehensive understanding of the development and application of organic chemistry, and also enhanced their friendship and academic exchanges.
117_1_0.summary: Discuss the molar structure of benzene

Together they explored basic concepts in topology, such as topological spaces, spheres, and manifolds, and delved into the proof process of the through-sphere theorem. Li Ming also showed strong interest in the applications of reduction mapping and shear mapping. During the discussion, they also recalled their fond memories of attending various social events and traveling together during their college days. Bao Juan was proud of Li Ming's achievements in the Internet field and expressed the hope that they could continue to maintain friendship and explore more mysteries of mathematics and science together.

117_6_0.content: On March 15, 2022, Bao Juan and Wang Fu decided to visit Xie Zhiliu’s calligraphy exhibition together. They heard that Xie Zhiliu was a famous calligrapher in modern China and had a strong interest in the art of calligraphy. Bao Juan suggested that they go together to appreciate Xie Zhiliu's works and understand his contribution to the art of calligraphy. Wang Fu was very interested. After his retirement, he had a strong interest in art and culture. Bao Juan and Wang Fu went to the exhibition venue together, where they admired one of Xie Zhiliu's masterpieces, 'Rainy Night Boating'. This work left a deep impression on them, and they were moved by the artistic conception and emotion in the work. Bao Juan explained to Wang Fu the painting theme of 'Rainy Night Boat' as well as the calligrapher's skills and ink use. They were immersed in this work and felt the humidity and tranquility on the river on a rainy night. During the exhibition, they also learned about Xie Zhiliu's deep understanding of Chinese characters and how he conveys his inner feelings through calligraphy. Bao Juan and Wang Fu were deeply attracted by Xie Zhiliu's works, and their understanding and appreciation of the art of calligraphy reached a new level. After the visit, they returned home, savored the artistic charm brought by the exhibition, and expressed their appreciation for Xie Zhiliu's talent and contribution. This shared artistic experience made the neighborhood relationship between Bao Juan and Wang Fu even closer. They decided to participate in more similar cultural activities together in the future and share beautiful moments together.

117_6_1.content: Bao Juan and Wang Fu are neighbors and they often participate in community activities and dinners together. The exhibition displays a variety of exquisite dough sculptures, including dragons and phoenixes, mythical beasts, figures, flowers, etc. Bao Juan was very interested in the art of dough sculpture, and she introduced the history and production process of dough sculpture to Wang Fu. Wang Fu was also attracted by these lifelike works, and together they carefully looked at the details of each work, such as eyes, ears, mouth and nose, etc. Bao Juan and Wang Fu were immersed in the world of dough sculpture art and felt the unique charm of traditional Chinese culture. After the exhibition, they tasted Lantern Festival rice dumplings and celebrated this traditional festival together. The experience of this dough sculpture exhibition allowed Bao Juan and Wang Fu to better understand the traditional Chinese festival of the Lantern Festival and the important role of dough sculptures in Chinese culture.

117_7_1.content: Bao Juan decided to visit the Blue Mosque in Istanbul over the weekend, and she invited community member Li Huiwen to go with her. Li Huiwen is an enthusiastic volunteer in Bao Juan's community and often organizes community activities and charity activities. Bao Juan and Li Huiwen met at community activities and became good friends. That day, they took public transportation together to the old city where the mosque is located. After arriving at their destination, they were attracted by the magnificent architecture of the mosque, especially the huge dome and blue tile decoration. Bao Juan shared with Li Huiwen the history and architectural features of the mosque, including the blue tiles on the dome and the hand-carved interior. Inside the mosque, they visited the central main hall and side halls, admiring the ornate stone and granite decorations. They were impressed by the detailed decoration inside the mosque, and together they admired the exquisite carvings and depictions of the Qur'an on the walls. In the courtyard of the mosque, Bao Juan and Li Huiwen felt tranquil and peaceful as they strolled around among orange and lemon trees and admired the Islamic architectural style displayed in the monastery and bell tower. This visit gave them a better understanding of Islam and Turkish culture. After the visit, Bao Juan and Li Huiwen tasted local specialties and spent a pleasant day together.

Shi Gang.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Shi Gang**

Shi Gang, known affectionately as Xiaogang, is a distinguished anthropologist hailing from China. At the age of 30, Xiaogang has already made significant contributions to the field of anthropology, earning accolades such as the Outstanding Dissertation Award. As a prominent figure in his profession, he is employed by the anthropology department of a renowned university, where his work continues to expand the horizons of cultural understanding.

Standing tall with a strong build, Shi Gang's deep eyes reflect his intellectual curiosity and passion for exploring diverse cultures. His short hair adds to his composed and professional demeanor, further enhancing his authoritative presence in academic circles. Driven by a profound desire to connect with people from all walks of life, Xiaogang is an avid traveler and photographer, capturing the essence of the world’s myriad cultures through his lens.

Shi Gang's academic journey in anthropology is influenced by the pioneering works of Thomas Malthus and Franz Boas, whose insights have shaped his approach to the study of human societies. His published research papers have contributed valuable knowledge to the field, earning him recognition amongst peers and scholars worldwide. Shi Gang's commitment to his craft and his role as a mentor and educator solidify his reputation as a leading anthropologist in modern academia.

118_6_0.content: This weekend, Shi Gang and his neighbor Xiao Zhang decided to visit the National Museum of China in Beijing. Shi Gang told Xiao Zhang that the National Museum of China is one of the largest museums in the world and houses many precious cultural heritages. They were both very interested in culture and history, so they decided to explore this treasure together. Upon arriving at the National Museum of China, they were struck by the size and splendor of the building. Shi Gang introduced to Xiao Zhang that the museum has collected more than 1 million artifacts, including manuscripts, sculptures, paintings, and other documents, covering a wide range of fields, such as history, literature, art, science, etc. When they toured the museum, they were particularly attracted by an exquisite ancient Chinese manuscript 'Huainanzi', which is a philosophical text with a thousand-year history and high cultural and artistic value. In addition, they also saw some special exhibitions, such as ancient maps of China, calligraphy works by renowned artists, and a collection of Ming Dynasty artifacts. Shi Gang and Xiao Zhang stopped in a quiet corner of the museum to read, study, and think quietly. They were attracted by the elaborate decoration of the museum, including traditional Chinese architecture, beautiful gardens, and detailed murals. They spent a pleasant time in this peaceful environment, exchanging their latest scientific research results. Finally, Shi Gang told Xiao Zhang that the museum also provides online access to collections through digital technology, allowing visitors to explore cultural heritage from anywhere in the world. Xiao Zhang said that such services are very convenient and can further promote the popularization of knowledge and culture. They both expressed their appreciation for the guardian role of the National Museum of China as it houses precious documents and cultural treasures from across the country and provides an important place for academic research and exchange of scholars.
118_6_0.summary: Visit the National Museum of China

Xia Yu.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Xia Yu**

Xia Yu, affectionately known as Xiaoyu, is a dedicated adult educator who has made significant contributions to the field of education in China. At 42 years old, Xia Yu embodies the essence of lifelong learning and empowerment through education. With a medium build and slightly curly long black hair, she is often seen wearing glasses that accentuate her thoughtful demeanor.

Her educational journey in adult education has equipped her with the skills and knowledge to inspire her students and foster a love for learning. Xia Yu works at an esteemed adult education institution, where her innovative teaching methods have earned her multiple honorary awards, including the prestigious Best Educator Award. Her approach is influenced by her role model, Li Hua, an exemplary adult educator whose legacy Xia Yu strives to honor through her work.

Beyond the classroom, Xiaoyu is passionate about reading, traveling, and practicing yoga, pursuits that enrich her understanding of the world and inform her teaching philosophy. Her Asian heritage deeply roots her commitment to education, driving her mission to uplift others through knowledge. Xia Yu’s life and work reflect her dedication to making a meaningful impact in adult education, inspiring others to pursue their own educational journeys.

Ge Xiaoyan.profile_description:
**Ge Xiaoyan: Education Law Expert**

Ge Xiaoyan, known affectionately as Xiaoyan, is a 35-year-old lawyer from China, celebrated for her expertise in education law. With an elegant temperament, long hair, and always seen with her signature glasses, Xiaoyan embodies the professionalism and dedication that have defined her career. 

She serves as a prominent figure at a well-known law firm, where her prowess in legal matters has led her to appear before international courts, defending many significant cases. Her academic contributions are substantial; she's authored numerous legal books that are considered vital resources in the field of education law.

Beyond her professional achievements, Xiaoyan's commitment to her craft is inspired by her father, a distinguished legal scholar and lawyer, who remains her role model. Her pursuit of excellence is reflected in her accolade as the Lawyer of the Year, a testament to her impact and dedication.

A Bachelor of Laws graduate, Xiaoyan balances her rigorous career with hobbies that enrich her life. She enjoys reading legal books, exploring new cultures through travel, and indulging in the serenity of drinking tea. Her Asian heritage blends seamlessly with her professional identity, making her a leading voice in the sphere of education law.

121_0_1.content: Ge Mingda is Ge Xiaoyan's brother and an excellent nutritionist. After he learned that his sister was an education law expert, he decided to make his own contribution to the sports world. After in-depth study and research, he focused on sports nutrition and obtained relevant professional qualifications. Ge Mingda observed during a football match that the team had some problems with diet, which directly affected the team's performance and the players' physical recovery. He realizes that proper dietary arrangements are crucial to an athlete's competitive ability and physical condition. Therefore, Ge Mingda proposed his own sports nutrition plan to the top football club. The club recognized his expertise and experience and decided to hire him to join the team as a nutritionist. Geminda works with the club's sports nutrition team and team coaches to customize a comprehensive diet plan to meet the unique needs of different athletes. He uses his knowledge and experience to assess each athlete's physical condition through regular physical exams and body composition analysis, and uses computational models based on individual nutritional needs to design daily meal plans. When formulating the diet plan, Ge Mingda fully considered the needs of athletes in different positions. He pays special attention to the high-calorie food intake of the forwards to keep them running fast and powerfully. He also focused on the midfielders' carbohydrate intake to increase their stamina. For goalkeepers, he will provide food rich in vitamin C and vitamin E to maintain their reaction speed and physical coordination. In addition to developing personalized diet plans, Geminda also monitors the nutritional intake of each athlete and conducts regular individual consultations with them to ensure that they understand and implement the diet plan correctly. Geminda's expertise and hard work have resulted in significant improvements to the team, with both players' physical fitness and competitive performance enhanced. His sports nutrition program is not just suitable for this football club, but can be widely used in various sports and play a key role in training.
121_0_1.summary: Geminda becomes nutritionist for a top football club

He is also committed to improving the intelligence level of the system so that it can continuously learn and adapt to different cases and provide doctors with more personalized and accurate diagnosis and treatment suggestions. Ge Mingda and Ge Xiaoyan work closely together to give full play to their respective expertise, jointly promote the innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment, and provide patients with better medical services. Their family backgrounds and common pursuits formed a tacit partnership on this important project.

121_4_0.content: In 2023, Ge Xiaoyan cooperated with Li Ming, her lawyer colleague for many years, and jointly participated in an important case regarding the Pearl River Basin Water Resources Management Project. The case involves the cooperative relationship between the Guangdong Provincial Government and water resources management departments, scientific research institutions and social enterprises, as well as the rational distribution and utilization of water resources. As an educational legal expert, Ge Xiaoyan is responsible for providing legal support and professional advice, while Li Ming is responsible for handling the specific procedures and document preparation of the case. They were fully prepared for the case by studying relevant laws, regulations, cases and previous experience with water management projects. During the defense process, Ge Xiaoyan used her legal expertise and rich experience to put forward a series of reasonable legal arguments and defense strategies to protect the water ecosystem of the Pearl River Basin and ensure the sustainable use of water resources. Li Ming assisted in sorting out relevant evidence and documents, and communicated and negotiated with relevant parties. They held many meetings and discussions with representatives from the Guangdong Provincial Government, water resources management departments and scientific research institutions to jointly develop a set of scientific and reasonable water resources management policies. During the case trial, they actively defended and presented relevant evidence to prove the legality and necessity of the project. In the end, Ge Xiaoyan and Li Ming's defense was successful, and the court ruled in favor of the project, recognizing the efforts and achievements of China's Guangdong Province in water resources management in the Pearl River Basin. Their defense work not only upheld justice, but also provided valuable experience and reference for global water resources management.
121_4_0.Theme: Pearl River Basin Water Resources Management Project

121_4_1.content: On May 12, 2018, Ge Xiaoyan and her lawyer colleague Li Ming, who had worked together for many years, went to the International Court of Justice to defend an important case related to the El Niño phenomenon. This case involves the phenomenon of ocean currents in the equatorial tropics, known as El Niño, which has an important impact on global climate and ecosystems. Ge Xiaoyan and Li Ming jointly defended the defendant and introduced the specific details and impact of El Niño in detail. They mentioned that the Peruvian Ocean Current almost stagnated during the El Niño event, causing the decline of fishery resources; the sea surface temperature in the equatorial eastern Pacific increased, causing the ecosystem in the water to be disturbed; the weakening of the high pressure belt in the eastern Pacific affected the global climate environment; seawater temperature and wind Changes in the ocean surface wind field have caused changes in the pattern, leading to the emergence of the anti-El Niño phenomenon. They provided solid support for the defense with their rich legal knowledge and professional experience, successfully defended the defendant and won the case. This cooperation has also further deepened the cooperative relationship between Ge Xiaoyan and Li Ming, and they have jointly made positive contributions to safeguarding justice and protecting the environment.
121_4_1.summary: Defending cases related to El Niño phenomenon

Cheng Hao.profile_description:
**Protagonist: Cheng Hao**

Cheng Hao, fondly known as Xiaohao, is a remarkable 28-year-old doctor from China. Tall and strong, he is easily recognizable by his short black hair and commanding presence. His journey in medicine has been nothing short of inspiring, marked by significant contributions to medical research and innovations that have garnered respect in his field. 

With a solid educational background in medicine, Cheng Hao has dedicated himself to advancing healthcare and improving patient outcomes. His commitment and prowess were nationally acknowledged when he clinched the national medical competition championship, a testament to his skill and dedication. He draws inspiration from Professor Zhang, a renowned Chinese doctor, whose work continues to influence Cheng’s medical ethos and aspirations.

Outside the hospital, Cheng Hao is a man of varied interests. He is an avid reader, always eager to explore new worlds through books. His passion for traveling has taken him to various places, enriching his understanding of global cultures and medical practices. Additionally, basketball offers him a perfect balance of physical activity and camaraderie, reflecting his team spirit both on and off the court. 

Cheng Hao's life is a blend of professional excellence and personal fulfillment, making him a figure of admiration and inspiration.

122_1_0.content: Researchers conducted an experiment called 'Brain Neural Mechanisms of Episodic Memory' in 2020. The experimental subject is a 28-year-old volunteer named Li Ming, who is an engineer. First, the researchers used magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) technology to scan Li Ming's brain. Then, they designed a memory test and asked Li Ming to watch a movie plot. In this plot, there is a hero named Tom and a heroine named Lili, who spent a happy time in a park. Later, Li Ming conducted a learning task related to this plot. He was asked to recall what happened in the movie and write down the details. In the next few days, the researchers constantly reminded Li Ming to recall the plot and strengthened his memory in different ways. Finally, after a week of memory training, the researchers scanned Li Ming's brain again. The results showed that Li Ming's activity in memory-related areas such as the hippocampus, prefrontal cortex, and temporal cortex was significantly enhanced. This shows that after memory training, Li Ming's brain's neural mechanism has been optimized and improved when he memorized this plot. In addition, the researchers also found that Li Ming's working memory improved when he recalled the plot. Working memory is the human brain's ability to store and process information in a short period of time. Through training, Li Ming's working memory capacity increased significantly, and he was able to better understand and remember complex situational information. Through this case, we can see that learning and memory have clear neural mechanisms in the individual brain. Through systematic memory training, people can improve their learning and memory abilities. This is of great significance to students, professionals and the elderly. Of course, this case is just one example, and there are many other studies and experiments exploring the mysteries of learning and memory. I hope this case can help you gain a deeper understanding of learning and memory.

They also tried special snacks from all over the world, including traditional pies from the north, dim sum from Guangdong and vegetarian rice dumplings from Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions. In the matching of the entire vegetable feast, the taste needs of all types of diners are taken into consideration. This vegetarian feast was not only delicious, but the nutritional mix was also very reasonable. Cheng Hao and Li Ming not only enjoyed the delicious food, but also gained rich nutritional value. Wanjuan.profile_description:
**Protagonist**: Wanjuan

Wanjuan, fondly known as Xiaojuan, is a distinguished dramatist hailing from China. At 30 years old, she has carved out a remarkable career as a drama teacher at a prestigious university, sharing her passion and expertise with aspiring performers and creators. With her long hair, Wanjuan possesses a commanding presence despite her short stature, which she skillfully utilizes in both her teaching and artistic pursuits.

Her dedication to the dramatic arts is reflected in her various hobbies, including acting, screenwriting, and directing. Her talents have been recognized through her impressive collection of awards, notably the Best Performance Award and Best Director Award, acknowledging her contributions to the field and her creative excellence.

Wanjuan’s achievements are underscored by her robust educational background in drama, which has equipped her with the knowledge and skills necessary to thrive in her occupation. Inspired by her role model, Li Shizhong, Wanjuan continues to evolve as an artist and educator, instilling in her students the same passion and determination that have fueled her own success.

Through her work and mentorship, Wanjuan leaves a lasting impact on the theatrical community, influencing future generations of dramatists and performers.

123_0_0.content: Wan Xiaomei and her sister Wan Juan are biological sisters, with a few years age difference. In the movie 'Zootopia' released in 2016, Wan Xiaomei, as a staff member of a media company, paid great attention to the dynamics of the film industry. When 'Zootopia' was released, she couldn't wait to buy two movie tickets and invited her sister Wanjuan to watch it together. They headed to a local movie theater on a weekend night and had a great movie-going experience. Wan Xiaomei was attracted by the exquisite and detailed animation in the film. She and her sister experienced the adventures of Judy and Nick, and uncovered the criminal conspiracy of the entire Animal City. After watching the movie, Wan Xiaomei spoke highly of the production and plot of the movie. She and her sister shared the joy and value of thinking brought by the movie.

123_0_1.content: In order to celebrate her sister Wan Xiaomei's birthday, Wan Juan decided to take her to Gwangju Laotan Bibimbap to enjoy a sumptuous Korean cuisine. They chose June 15, 2022, to go to this famous restaurant in Myeongdong District, central Seoul. The environment of Gwangju Laodan Bibimbap is very comfortable, with elegant decoration, giving people a peaceful feeling. Wan Juan and Wan Xiaomei sat on the carpet, as if returning to the traditional Korean dining style. When the waiter brought the beef bibimbap to the table, both of them were attracted by its fragrant aroma. This dish uses rice, beef, Korean kimchi, chives and various vegetables as the main ingredients, and is made with traditional stir-fried techniques. Wan Juan and Wan Xiaomei took a bite and felt the tenderness of the beef and the sourness and spiciness of Korean kimchi in their mouths. The texture of the rice and the crispy crispy rice also gave them the ultimate enjoyment of delicious food. They also sampled other amazing dishes such as traditional Korean kimchi pancakes and spicy tteokbokki. Throughout the meal, Wan Juan and Wan Xiaomei were very satisfied. They felt the authentic Korean cuisine. This birthday dinner brought the sisters closer together and created wonderful memories.
123_0_1.summary: The signature dish of Gwangju Nodan Bibimbap

123_1_0.content: Wan Juan and Wang Mingyang were college classmates and are now screenwriters and drama teachers. They often collaborate on screenplays together. Recently, they decided to collaborate on a theater production inspired by Pride and Prejudice. They researched the novel together and transferred the setting of the story to modern Chinese urban society. Wang Mingyang is responsible for writing the framework and dialogue of the script, while Wan Juan is responsible for the training of the director and actors. After repeated discussions and revisions, they gradually improved the plot and characters of the script. Wan Juan decided to play the heroine Elizabeth Bennett herself, while Wang Mingyang played Mr. Darcy in the play. Their collaboration is full of tacit understanding and creativity, constantly adding new plots and dialogues to the script. They hope that through this dramatic work, they can reinterpret the phenomenon of verbal violence in Pride and Prejudice and remind the audience of their choice of words and respect for others.

123_1_1.content: Wan Juan is friends with her college classmate Wang Mingyang, and they often collaborate on writing scripts together. Together they explore all aspects of theater production, including acting, writing and directing. Their collaborative projects and their scripts have won numerous theater acting awards. They inspired each other during the creative process and worked together to create rich and diverse characters and storylines. Wang Mingyang has a unique talent in screenwriting and is able to create deeply rooted plots and vivid characters. As a drama teacher, Wan Juan uses her professional knowledge and experience to provide valuable guidance and suggestions for scripts. Their working relationship is close and harmonious, and their work has been widely recognized and praised as a result.

123_1_2.content: Wan Juan and Wang Mingyang collaborated to create a drama related to 'Avengers: Infinity War'. In their work, Wang Mingyang plays the God of Thunder and engages in a fierce battle with Thanos. Wan Juan was responsible for screenwriting and directing, and carefully designed the battle scenes in the Maya stronghold. Their work has been warmly received by the audience, and the scenes and action scenes in the drama are jaw-dropping. This cooperation allowed Wan Juan and Wang Mingyang to have a deeper understanding of each other's talents and creative concepts, and also deepened their friendship.
123_1_2.summary: Battle of the Mayan stronghold in Norway

123_2_0.content: Wan Juan and Chen Yu decided to go to Li Xiaoming's concert together. They purchased their concert tickets in advance and couldn't wait for this exciting night. The venue of the concert is Beijing's Bird's Nest Stadium, a famous venue capable of accommodating large audiences. Wan Juan and Chen Yu are both loyal fans of Li Xiaoming. They like his music and his positive image. Before the concert started, they excitedly waited with other fans to enter. After the concert began, Wan Juan and Chen Yu were immersed in the ocean of music. They appreciated Li Xiaoming's unique musical talent and danced to the melody of the song. Throughout the concert, they remained in close physical contact and shared this wonderful moment. When Li Xiaoming sang their favorite song, they couldn't help but hold hands and feel the power of music together. After the concert, they left the Bird's Nest Stadium with excitement and joy, recalling this unforgettable night.
123_2_0.Theme: Romantic relationship between Wan Juan and Chen Yu

123_2_1.content: Wan Juan and Chen Yu are a romantic couple. They both love drama and pursue a common dream. They often create, rehearse and perform together, exploring the infinite possibilities of theatre. Wan Juan is experienced as a drama teacher and dramatist. She has outstanding talents in acting, screenwriting and directing. Chen Yu is a stage designer who is good at creating exquisite stage settings and lighting effects for theatrical works, presenting a stunning visual feast to theater audiences. They encouraged and supported each other, and together they created many unforgettable theatrical works. Whether it is the creative process in the rehearsal room or the wonderful performance on the stage, they have demonstrated a golden combination of tacit understanding and collaboration. Wan Juan and Chen Yu inspire each other to constantly pursue excellence in dramatic art, and hope to use their works to convey more emotions and thinking. The road to their dreams is full of challenges and difficulties, but they firmly believe that through unremitting efforts and firm belief, they will be able to create more exciting drama works and let the audience feel the charm and power of drama.
123_2_1.summary: Pursue the dream of theater art together

123_2_2.content: Wan Juan and Chen Yu are a couple who love drama. They are both passionate about drama and pursue their artistic dreams together. In the summer of 2019, they decided to put aside their busy schedules and go on a romantic trip. They chose Venice, Italy as their destination. Venice is famous for its romantic waterside scenery and long theatrical history. One day in Venice, they strolled along the canal, admiring the beautiful buildings and bridges, as if they were walking into an ancient theater stage. Wan Juan and Chen Yu also visited local theaters and art exhibitions, communicating and sharing experiences with local dramatists and actors. One night, they went to a small theater to watch a traditional Italian theater performance. Wan Juan and Chen Yu were moved by the actors' superb performances and dramatic stories, and were deeply immersed in the world of drama. On their last day in Venice, they took a trip on an ancient ship to the beautiful island of Toledo. There is a small theater on the island, where Wan Juan and Chen Yu staged a wonderful drama performance, attracting tourists and local residents on the island. This romantic trip not only made Wan Juan and Chen Yu feel the charm of drama art, but also deepened their relationship and strengthened their determination to pursue their dream of drama.
123_2_2.Theme: Wan Juan and Chen Yu’s romantic journey

123_3_0.content: As a drama director mentor, Wan Juan had in-depth drama exchanges with Li Jia. After learning that Li Jia's daughter was sick, Wan Juan offered to help. In the movie 'Happy House', Wan Juan created an interlude scene to express Li Jia's mood. In this scene, Li Jia is alone at home, worryingly taking care of her sick daughter. In order to increase the reality of the drama, Wan Juan invited a child actor to play Li Jia's daughter, and arranged a touching dialogue to show Li Jia's maternal love and selfless dedication. Wan Juan carefully guided Li Jia to help her get into the role, allowing her to truly convey her emotions to the audience through her performance. This scene resonated strongly in the movie, and the audience was deeply moved by the motherly love shown by Li Jia. This is also the result of the profound drama communication between Wanjuan and Li Jia. Through her professional knowledge and experience, she helped Li Jia fully demonstrate her acting skills, allowing her to play a very important role in this movie.

123_3_1.content: In 2020, Wan Juan directed a high-profile drama 'The New York Times'. This work is based on a famous film about a cat-and-mouse game between the New York Police Department and Irish gangsters. Wan Juan invited Li Jia to star as a supporting role. He played a smart and cunning gang member in the play. Wan Juan admired Li Jia's acting skills very much and believed that he could interpret the complexity and psychological state of the character well. During the cooperation between the crew, Wan Juan and Li Jia had profound dramatic exchanges, and jointly discussed the creation of characters and the expression of plots. They inspire each other and work together to make The New York Times even better. Wan Juan is very satisfied with Li Jia's performance in the play. His superb acting skills add a special charm to the work. This cooperation also made the relationship between Wan Juan and Li Jia closer, and they became good friends in the field of drama.

123_3_2.content: On May 10, 2018, Wan Juan organized a drama exchange event as a drama teacher at a university. This event attracted many theater lovers, including her mentor Li Jia. Li Jia is Wanjuan's old friend, and they have long-term exchanges and cooperation in the theater world. During the event, Wan Juan and Li Jia shared each other's drama experience and discussed the latest drama trends and creative concepts. They also reviewed the works they had collaborated with and discussed the challenges and breakthrough points in drama creation. Wan Juan admires Li Jia's talent and creative ability very much. She praised Li Jia's outstanding performance in a recent drama work and invited him to participate in future cooperation projects. This drama exchange not only deepened the friendship between Wan Juan and Li Jia, but also brought new inspiration and opportunities to their drama careers.
123_3_2.Theme: Drama exchange between drama director mentor and Li Jia

123_4_0.content: Wan Juan is a drama teacher, and she and Liu Yang are colleagues in the drama department of the university. They often participate in teaching and performance work together, and jointly discuss the concepts and techniques of drama creation. As a dramatist, Wan Juan has rich experience and talent in screenwriting and directing, while Liu Yang is good at acting, and his acting skills and performance style complement each other with Wan Juan. Their joint teaching courses and drama works have won many awards, among which Wan Juan won the Best Director Award and Liu Yang won the Best Performance Award. Their tacit cooperation and good working relationship have made them the best in the drama department and they have been praised by students and peers alike.
123_4_0.summary: Wan Juan collaborates with Liu Yang to participate in teaching and performance work
123_4_0.Theme: Liu Yang's performance among colleagues in the university drama department

123_4_1.content: As colleagues in the drama department, Wan Juan and Liu Yang often collaborate together in teaching and performance work at a university. One day, in their free time, they decided to browse the ukiyo-e works of the Edo period together. They went to a local museum and admired many famous ukiyo-e works. Among them, Wan Juan was deeply attracted by Katsushika Hokusai's work 'Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji'. She was shocked by the print 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' depicting huge waves, and couldn't help but admire Hokusai's unique style and expression techniques. Liu Yang was interested in Utagawa Hiroshige's work 'The Fifty-Three Times on the Tokaido Road'. Through a series of prints, he gained an in-depth understanding of the various stations and scenery along the Tokaido Road in the Edo period. Wan Juan and Liu Yang exchanged their views and feelings while admiring these classic ukiyo-e works, enriching each other's artistic insights and accumulation of drama materials. This experience of browsing Ukiyo-e works not only enhanced the relationship between Wan Juan and Liu Yang as colleagues, but also provided them with more inspiration and creativity for their future teaching and performance work.

123_4_2.content: On Tuesday afternoon, Wan Juan was teaching and performing together with her colleague Liu Yang from the drama department in the teaching building of the university's drama department. Together they rehearsed and discussed the upcoming play 'Shattered Memories'. Liu Yang is the director of the play, and Wan Juan is the protagonist of the play, Anna Miller. They worked closely together in the rehearsal room to study the character's inner world and emotional expression. Liu Yang admired Wanjuan's acting talent very much, and he often gave her guidance and encouragement. Cheng Jun.profile_description:
**Cheng Jun (Kotoshi): Profile Description**

Cheng Jun, fondly known as Kotoshi among his peers, is a distinguished land resource manager at the age of 30. As a proud representative of the Han nationality from China, Cheng has cultivated a reputable career in land resource management, working for a local government body. Armed with a solid educational background in land resource management, Cheng has led and successfully completed numerous projects in his field. 

A well-respected figure, Cheng's dedication and prowess have been acknowledged through his receipt of the Outstanding Land Resource Manager Award. He draws inspiration from Li Feng, a seasoned expert revered for his significant contributions to land management, whom Cheng considers a key role model. 

Physically, Cheng is recognized by his short hair, glasses, and a well-proportioned figure, embodying a professional and approachable demeanor. Beyond his professional accomplishments, Cheng is a passionate traveler and an avid photographer, often capturing the essence of landscapes and communities during his travels. A lover of reading, he continuously seeks knowledge and personal growth. 

Cheng Jun’s commitment to excellence and sustainable land management practices make him a vital asset to his community and a leader in his industry.

124_0_0.content: In 2018, Cheng Jun’s younger brother Cheng Liang followed him to pay attention to the trends in the art market. At that time, Van Gogh's painting 'Starry Night' attracted much attention in the auction market. Cheng Liang is very interested in art, especially the works of Van Gogh. He studied the historical background and artistic value of 'Starry Night' and actively participated in discussions in the art world. Together with Cheng Jun, he discussed the painting's artistic style and its influence on subsequent artists. Cheng Liang paid special attention to the results of this auction, hoping to learn the latest value of 'Starry Night'. In the end, this work was sold at an astonishing price, attracting widespread attention from the art world and collectors. Cheng Liang was excited about the news and shared this important event with Cheng Jun. Together they discussed the status and value of Van Gogh's works in the art market and shared their unique insights into art. This auction made Cheng Liang love art even more and inspired him to continue exploring the field of art.

124_3_0.content: On a sunny morning on a weekend, Cheng Jun was preparing to cook his favorite French beef and wine stew. He loves cooking and has a deep interest in the dish. He was busy preparing the ingredients, slicing beef, onions, carrots and garlic cloves and preparing cooked smoked bacon. At this moment, Liu Ming walked into the kitchen and greeted Cheng Jun. Liu Ming is an acquaintance of Cheng Jun in the community. They occasionally meet in the community and exchange some common interests and hobbies. Liu Ming also has a certain interest in cooking. After hearing that Cheng Jun was preparing to make French beef and wine stew, he volunteered to taste this delicacy together. Cheng Jun readily agreed, and the two began to work together to prepare the dish. They follow the steps to prepare the beef, rub it with flour, salt and pepper, then cook and smoke the bacon. When the beef is stir-fried in the stew pot, Liu Ming helps stir-fry to ensure that the beef is evenly heated. Next, together they add the onions, garlic cloves, carrots and cooked smoked bacon to the saucepan and cook until the onions are lightly browned. Then they added the red wine and beef broth, covered the saucepan and placed it in a preheated oven to simmer on low for 3-4 hours. During the stew, they chatted and shared their thoughts and experiences on cooking. Finally, after a long period of slow cooking, the French beef wine stew becomes extremely tender and exudes an alluring aroma. Cheng Jun and Liu Ming tasted this delicious dish together and praised its delicate texture. The tenderness of the beef and the aroma of the red wine perfectly blended, as if a flower exploded on the tip of the tongue. They also paired it with some pasta and fresh baguette to round out the meal. After tasting the perfect meal, Cheng Jun and Liu Ming thanked each other for their cooperation and said they could explore more food together next time.
124_3_0.summary: Let’s taste French beef and wine stew together

124_8_1.content: Cheng Jun and Liu Juan met unexpectedly at a social gathering. They often met in public places and nodded to each other. He mentioned that at the end of the 19th century, some European hares were introduced to Australia for hunting and food purposes. However, these rabbits quickly multiplied and became an invasive local species. Cheng Jun told Liu Juan that rabbits feed on a large number of plants, causing damage to local vegetation and posing a threat to other wild animals and plants. In addition, rabbits may spread diseases and affect the survival of other wild species. He introduced the measures taken by the Australian government to control rabbit invasion, such as introducing natural enemies of rabbits and spraying rabbit-killing grass. However, the effectiveness of these measures is limited, and rabbit invasion problems remain serious. After hearing this, Liu Juan expressed her concern and worry about the case of rabbit invasion. She believed that the impact of species invasion on the ecosystem is multi-faceted, and emphasized the importance of being cautious when introducing species. Cheng Jun and Liu Juan had an in-depth discussion on this case and jointly discussed how to better manage the problem of species invasion and protect the sustainable development of the ecological environment.

Yao’s achievements extend beyond academia; she actively participates in various media projects, translating theory into practice.
